table.name: Injector Scaling
table.description:
Injector size constant, shown as the injector flow (g/s) the ECU assumes at the 0.3 MPa reference of Injector Flow Compensation; stock 2.61 g/s, which the stock compensation curve makes about 15.2 g/s at 10 MPa. For new injectors scale it by new flow / stock flow (raw value by stock / new). Cranking pulses, latency, minimum pulse and the throttle-rate transient fuel are in microseconds and do not follow it.
Details: Injector size constant, read as the injector flow the ECU assumes at the reference pressure of Injector Flow Compensation (where that table is 256: 0.3 MPa in stock). 0x0B8030 (read) computes FFF8ADEA = air quantity FFF8C250 x this x 0.10266 / 14.7 / 4 / rpm x 0.125, and 0x0D15EC (read) the base pulse FFF8C05C = 16 x FFF8ADEA x fuel-trim factors (1.0 at nominal trims) in microseconds; 0x0D1528 then applies the fuel factor and 0x0D2BB8 the flow compensation and latency. Result: base pulse [us at 0.3 MPa] = 131.40 x this x stoichiometric fuel mass per cylinder per cycle [g], i.e. flow = 7610.3 / this g/s (shown). Stock 2918 = 2.61 g/s at 0.3 MPa, which the stock compensation curve makes 15.2 g/s at 10 MPa. For new injectors set the reference flow to new flow at 10 MPa x 44/256 (if Injector Flow Compensation is kept), or equivalently scale the raw value by stock flow / new flow. Stock 2918 in both images. Not scaled by this value (must be rescaled by hand when it changes): Injector Latency, Minimum Pulse Width, the cranking pulses (Cranking Fuel tables, Cranking Fuel Secondary), Transient Fuel Throttle-Rate Gain and Term Minimum, and the HPFP fuel-quantity axes, which are all in microseconds of pulse; the open-loop/enrichment tables and Transient Fuel Film Target are mass-based and follow automatically (read: cal 0x1C6EE is read by 0x0B8030, the film step 0x0F6B18 and the Tip-In Extra Pulse step 0x0F54B8 (off in stock), which also scales with it). LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 01C6EE by the code that reads it (read). Address 022C1E. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Injector Latency
table.description:
Fixed time added to every injection pulse, by rail pressure; probably the injector opening delay. Raise it if the injectors open slower than stock.
Details: Added to every injection pulse: 0x0D3848 writes FFF8B08C = this(rail pressure) [+ Injector Latency Adder], and 0x0D2BB8 adds FFF8B08C x 0.8 us to the fuel time (read). Interpreted as injector opening delay (inferred). LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 05B258 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 009DFC. Confidence: read.

table.name: Injector Latency Adder
table.description:
Extra latency added only while an injector-driver fault (P062D / P2146) is active. No effect on a healthy car.
Details: Added to Injector Latency (saturating) only while FFF88F4A bit 1 is set (0x0C7808 / 0x0D3848, read). That bit is the injector-driver fault flag set by 0x080B96 (P062D / P2146; the same bit selects Rail Pressure Fail-Safe Target A, read), so this is a fault-mode latency: no effect on a healthy car. LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 05B264 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 009E08. Confidence: read.

table.name: Injector Flow Compensation (Injectors 1/3)
table.description:
Multiplier on the fuel quantity of injectors 1 and 3 by rail pressure: more pressure means more flow, so less pulse. Stock follows the injector flow-versus-pressure law referenced to 0.3 MPa. Keep equal to Injector Flow Compensation (Injectors 2/4).
Details: When used: Used by the pulse functions of injectors 1 and 3 (read); injectors 2 and 4 use Injector Flow Compensation (Injectors 2/4). Multiplier on the fuel quantity of every injection: pulse = latency + quantity x this / 256 (0x0D2BB8), looked up from rail pressure FFF88886 by 0x0CB0C8 into FFF8AFEA (read). Stock values follow sqrt(0.3 MPa / P) - 256 at 0.3 MPa, 29 at 24 MPa - the injector flow-versus-pressure law, so the base pulse is referenced to 0.3 MPa (inferred). LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 05A838 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 009114. Confidence: read.

table.name: Injector Flow Compensation (Injectors 2/4)
table.description:
Same as Injector Flow Compensation (Injectors 1/3) but for injectors 2 and 4 (rail pressure plus Injector 2/4 Rail Pressure Offset). Stock identical; keep the two equal unless you deliberately trim one bank.
Details: When used: by the pulse functions of injectors 2 and 4 (0x0D2EDC / 0x0D300C / 0x0D3524 / 0x0D3654, read). Looked up by 0x0CB0C8 from FFF89222 = rail pressure FFF88886 + Injector 2/4 Rail Pressure Offset (all zero in stock) into FFF8AFEC (read). Same shape and stock values as Injector Flow Compensation (Injectors 1/3); keep them equal unless deliberately trimming one bank (bank reading inferred). LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 05A844 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 009120. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Injector Minimum Pulse Width
table.description:
Shortest pulse the ECU will command; any shorter computed pulse is raised to this. Adjust for injectors with a different minimum controllable pulse.
Details: Floor for every injection pulse: 0x0D2BB8 takes the larger of the computed pulse and this value (FFF8B088, from 0x0D2B9C) before the 1 s cap at cal 0x11CFC (read). LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 05B24C by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 009DF0. Confidence: read.

table.name: Per-Injector Fuel Trim 1
table.description:
Fuel multiplier for cylinder 1 only, by fuel quantity and rpm (128 = no change), applied before the pulse is split into injections. Use it to balance individual cylinders. Stock all 128 (no effect).
Details: Multiplier on injector 1's fuel quantity before the split into injections: 0x0D168C writes FFF8C060 = quantity x this(quantity, rpm) / 128 + the per-cylinder transient (wall-film + throttle-rate) fuel term FFF8C1E4 (0x0F6260; not learned: 0x8000 = none, reset to 0x8000 outside running; adds 4 x (term - 32768) counts) (read). Order 1-4 is the order the code processes FFF8C060-C06C; the transient fuel module's cylinder masks (05C8A0-05C8C4, read in 0x0F5AD0) only fit firing order 1-3-2-4 if slot n is cylinder n+1, so 1-4 is the cylinder number (inferred, strong). All 128 (no change) in stock. LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 05B1FC by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 009DA0. Confidence: read.

table.name: Per-Injector Fuel Multiplier 1 (Single Injection)
table.description:
Fuel multiplier for injector 1 when it fires once per cycle, which appears to be the stock case (128 = x1.0). Stock all 128, so it has no effect.
Details: When used: Strategy byte = injections per cycle (FFF8A69E, 0x0CF3EC, read): this one applies with one injection (the stock case). Written to FFF8A6A3 by 0x0CF630 (read). Injector 1's quantity (0x0D168C) is multiplied by this / 128 when that injector's strategy byte FFF8A69F equals 1 (read). The strategy byte is probably the number of injections per cycle (inferred from the split-injection code). All 128 (x1.0) in stock. LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 05ADE8 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 0098A4. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Injector 2/4 Rail Pressure Offset
table.description:
Pressure offset added to measured rail pressure before looking up Injector Flow Compensation (Injectors 2/4), by rpm and load; probably the pressure difference of the rail without the sensor. Stock all 0 (no effect).
Details: 0x06D43A (read): FFF89222 = sat(rail pressure FFF88886 + this(rpm FFF8CE9C, load FFF8A616)), interpolated by 0x00671C (descriptor 0x0608E4: data, u16 axis, u8 axis, 16, 16; row = rpm, read). FFF89222 indexes the injector flow compensation 05A844 used only for injectors 2 and 4 (0x0CB0C8, read); injectors 1 and 3 use 05A838 with FFF88886. Likely the pressure difference of the rail without the sensor (inferred from the boxer layout). Signed, in the rail-pressure unit. Stock all 0 (2015, 2016). LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 0608E4 by its caller in the decompiled code (read). Evidence: FUN_0000684c(&0x063438, rpm FFF8E51C, load FFF8BA26) added to the rail pressure and saturated, the same code as LF75404S 0x06D43A (read); descriptor {data, rpm axis u16, load axis u8, 16, 16} read from the image. Descriptor boot 063438. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Target Rail Pressure
table.description:
Main fuel rail pressure target in normal warm running, by load and rpm. Higher pressure = better atomisation and more injector flow at the cost of pump load. Replaced by Target Rail Pressure (Pedal Released) with the pedal released. Stock 3 MPa at light load, rising to 15 MPa from about 1.29 g/rev (100 %) at 3,600 rpm and above, but only from about 2.1-2.6 g/rev (160-200 %) below 3,600 rpm.
Details: Rail-pressure target 0x165180 (called from the HPFP module 0x164804, read) writes FFF8B9A0, the target used by the pump feedback and the P0087/P0088 monitor. Normal running (combustion mode FFF8A85C = 4 and engine state FFF99844 = 3; cal 0x3F28C = 0 makes the wait timer zero): target = base byte table x 150 counts. The byte target is held at its previous value while it changes by less than cal 0x3F28A (4 = 0.37 MPa), and capped at cal 0x3F39A x 153/28 (no cap in stock). This is the main base table: load FFF8A616 x rpm FFF8CD56. If FFF8A774 bit 0 is set it is replaced by Target Rail Pressure (Pedal Released); with no sensor faults (FFF88E28 bit 2, FFF88E2B bit 5 clear) Target Rail Pressure Additive x Additive Multiplier / 255 is added. Stock 3.0 MPa at light load to 15.0 MPa from about 1.81 g/rev (140 % load). LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 05EB24 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 00DC60. Confidence: read.

table.name: Target Rail Pressure (Pedal Released)
table.description:
Rail pressure target used instead of Target Rail Pressure while the accelerator is fully released (cranking or running), by coolant. Stock 7 MPa cold to 3 MPa hot.
Details: When used: Replaces Target Rail Pressure while FFF8A774 bit 0 is set: accelerator fully released while cranking or running (0x0E127C / 0x09FF9A, read). 0x165180 (read): replaces Target Rail Pressure while FFF8A774 bit 0 is set (the same flag selects Base Timing (Pedal Released, TGV Closed/Open)); coolant FFF88A44. Stock 7.0 MPa cold to 3.0 MPa hot. LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 05EB90 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 00DCE4. Confidence: read.

table.name: Target Rail Pressure Additive
table.description:
Extra rail pressure added to Target Rail Pressure, scaled by Target Rail Pressure Additive Multiplier, only with no rail-pressure sensor faults. Stock all 0, so it has no effect.
Details: 0x165180 (read): added to Target Rail Pressure (in its byte units) after scaling by Target Rail Pressure Additive Multiplier / 255, only while FFF88E28 bit 2 and FFF88E2B bit 5 are clear; result clipped to 0...255. All 0 in stock. LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 05EB38 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 00DC74. Confidence: read.

table.name: Target Rail Pressure Additive Multiplier
table.description:
Scaling (255 = x1.0) for Target Rail Pressure Additive, by an unidentified input and what is probably intake air temperature. Stock all 0, so the additive is off.
Details: 0x165180 (read): multiplier (/255) on Target Rail Pressure Additive, looked up from FFF88A9D (unidentified) and FFF88662 (intake air temperature + 50, inferred). All 0 in stock. LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 05EBB0 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 00DD04. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Target Rail Pressure (Combustion Mode 0)
table.description:
Rail pressure target in the first phase after start (combustion mode 0), by coolant and rpm. Stock 10-15 MPa.
Details: 0x165180 (read): target x 150 while combustion mode FFF8A85C is 0 (first phase after start), coolant FFF88A44 x rpm FFF8CD56 (400...1,600 rpm). Stock 10.0...15.0 MPa. LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 05EB70 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 00DCAC. Confidence: read.

table.name: Target Rail Pressure (Combustion Mode 4, Start Delay)
table.description:
Rail pressure target used in normal running mode only during a start delay before the engine counts as running. The delay is 0 in stock, so it is normally skipped. Stock 10 MPa.
Details: 0x165180 (read): used in combustion mode 4 instead of Target Rail Pressure until the engine is running (FFF99844 = 3) and the counter FFF86A54 >= cal 0x3F28C (0 in stock, so it is normally skipped). Stock 10.0 MPa. LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 05EB9C by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 00DCF0. Confidence: read.

table.name: Target Rail Pressure (Combustion Mode 3, Pedal Released)
table.description:
Rail pressure target in combustion mode 3 (the phase before normal running) with the accelerator fully released, by coolant. Stock 15 MPa cold to 3 MPa hot.
Details: When used: FFF88C64 bit 5 = accelerator fully released (0 % for 2 passes, cleared at 0.25 %; 0x09FF9A, read). 0x165180 (read): target in combustion mode FFF8A85C = 3 while FFF88C64 bit 5 is set (else Target Rail Pressure (Combustion Mode 3, Pedal Applied)); coolant FFF88A44. Stock 15 MPa cold to 3 MPa hot. LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 05EB58 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 00DC94. Confidence: read.

table.name: Target Rail Pressure (Combustion Mode 3, Pedal Applied)
table.description:
Rail pressure target in combustion mode 3 (the phase before normal running) with the accelerator pressed, by coolant. Stock 15 MPa cold to 8 MPa hot.
Details: When used: Combustion mode 3 with the accelerator applied (FFF88C64 bit 5 clear, read). 0x165180 (read): target in combustion mode 3 while FFF88C64 bit 5 is clear. Stock 15 MPa cold to 8 MPa hot. LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 05EB64 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 00DCA0. Confidence: read.

table.name: Target Rail Pressure (Combustion Mode 1)
table.description:
Rail pressure target in combustion mode 1 (an early warm-up phase); the one the stock car uses, since the fallback version never activates. Stock 15 MPa flat.
Details: When used: The combustion mode 1 target in stock (FFF899D7 bit 0 never sets, read). 0x165180 (read): target in combustion mode 1 while FFF899D7 bit 0 is clear. Stock 15 MPa flat. LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 05EB4C by its caller in the decompiled code (read). Evidence: Phase 11: the selector flag (2017 FFF8AD5A bit 0, 2018 FFF8BC16 bit 0, 2015 FFF8A7E2 bit 0) is state FFF8AD55 in {1,2,3,4,6} (0x103C64 / 0x0FD5FC in 2017). State 1 is forced while FFF889FB bit 7 (2015 FFF886AB bit 7) is set, and that bit is set permanently by the transmission coding cal (2015 0x2F794/0x2F796, 2017 0x36B70/0x36B72, 2018 0x37FEC/0x37FEE: bit 1 clear, bit 6 clear) in all four stock images (read). So the flag-set table is the one the stock (manual) car uses; the flag-clear table is for the other coding, whose state machine uses engine speed minus a received transmission speed (AT/CVT, inferred). rail-pressure selection 0x1693A4, combustion mode 1, fallback flag clear (read). Descriptor 00DC88. Confidence: read.

table.name: Target Rail Pressure (Combustion Mode 1, AT/CVT Coding)
table.description:
AT/CVT version of Target Rail Pressure (Combustion Mode 1). Only used with the automatic/CVT transmission coding; no effect on a manual car.
Details: When used: Only with the automatic/CVT transmission coding (Cal Switches: Transmission Coding: Automatic/CVT); unused on a manual car (read). LF9C100P: a table LF75404S does not have; scaling and axes as Target Rail Pressure (Combustion Mode 1). Evidence: Phase 11: the selector flag (2017 FFF8AD5A bit 0, 2018 FFF8BC16 bit 0, 2015 FFF8A7E2 bit 0) is state FFF8AD55 in {1,2,3,4,6} (0x103C64 / 0x0FD5FC in 2017). State 1 is forced while FFF889FB bit 7 (2015 FFF886AB bit 7) is set, and that bit is set permanently by the transmission coding cal (2015 0x2F794/0x2F796, 2017 0x36B70/0x36B72, 2018 0x37FEC/0x37FEE: bit 1 clear, bit 6 clear) in all four stock images (read). So the flag-set table is the one the stock (manual) car uses; the flag-clear table is for the other coding, whose state machine uses engine speed minus a received transmission speed (AT/CVT, inferred). This is the flag-clear table, not used by the stock calibration. rail-pressure selection 0x1693A4, combustion mode 1, fallback flag clear (read). Descriptor 00DCD8. Confidence: read.

table.name: Target Rail Pressure (Catalyst Heating)
table.description:
Fixed rail pressure target during stratified catalyst heating (combustion mode 2). Stock 15 MPa.
Details: 0x165180 (read): fixed target in combustion mode FFF8A85C = 2 (stratified catalyst heating). Stock 24590 = 15.0 MPa. LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 03F288 by its caller in the decompiled code (read). Evidence: (read) Counterpart reader(s) 0x165180->0x1693A4 (ref 1 access(es), target 1, size [2]); decompile token alignment puts this cal at the position of LF75404S 0x03F288 (1 reference(s), votes {'04BCBE': 1}); machine-code effective addresses of the target function confirm 0x04BCBE is accessed as u16. Stock 24590 (LF75404S 24590). Matches the layout address. Address 04BCBE. Confidence: read.

table.name: Rail Pressure Fail-Safe Target A
table.description:
Rail pressure target while an injector-driver fault (P062D / P2146) is active; stock 0.35 MPa, which appears to mean no high-pressure pumping. No effect on a healthy car.
Details: 0x165180 (read): target while FFF88F4A bit 1 is set (injector-driver faults P062D / P2146, set by 0x080B96, read); if bit 2 is also set the lower of A and B is used. Stock 574 = 0.35 MPa, i.e. no high-pressure pumping (inferred). LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 03F50E by its caller in the decompiled code (read). Evidence: (read) Counterpart reader(s) 0x165180->0x1693A4 (ref 2 access(es), target 2, size [2]); decompile token alignment puts this cal at the position of LF75404S 0x03F50E (2 reference(s), votes {'04BF44': 2}); machine-code effective addresses of the target function confirm 0x04BF44 is accessed as u16. Stock 574 (LF75404S 574). Matches the layout address. Address 04BF44. Confidence: read.

table.name: Rail Pressure Fail-Safe Target B
table.description:
Second fail-safe rail pressure target; the lower of A and B is used when both apply. Nothing that activates it was found, so it probably never applies. Stock 0.35 MPa.
Details: 0x165180 (read): target while FFF88F4A bit 2 is set. No setter of that bit was found in either image. Stock 574 = 0.35 MPa. Stock 574 (LF75404S 574). Matches the layout address. Address 04BF42. Confidence: read.

table.name: HPFP Feedforward Command
Fuel Quantity (us (injector pulse, 0.3 MPa ref, incl. latency))
table.scaling: us (injector pulse 0.3 MPa ref incl. latency) uint16

table.description:
Open-loop high-pressure pump command (a crank angle) by fuel quantity and rpm; the pressure controller adds its correction on top. Lower angles appear to mean more pump delivery. The fuel-quantity axis is in microseconds of injector pulse, so it must be rescaled when Injector Scaling changes.
Details: 0x16474C (read): open-loop pump command FFF8B984 from fuel quantity FFF8AFEE (injector pulse words / 8, 0x0CB0F4) x rpm FFF8CD56. Command FFF8B99A = this + proportional + integral/16 (0x164778, 0x165094), clamped to cal 0x3ED0E...0x3ED10+0x3ED16 (2,250...3,450). Lower values at higher fuel quantity, i.e. lower command = more delivery (inferred). LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 05EAB8 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 00DBF4. Confidence: read.

table.name: HPFP Proportional Gain
table.description:
Proportional gain of the rail-pressure controller, by rpm: how hard the pump command reacts to pressure error. Higher = faster but risks oscillation. Stock high below 800 rpm, lower in the mid range.
Details: 0x164DB0 (read): proportional term FFF8B996 = (actual rail pressure FFF88884 - target FFF8B9A0) x this / 41967, saturated to s16. Stock 6400 below 800 rpm, 1280 from 2,000-4,500 rpm, 2048 above. LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 05EB04 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 00DC40. Confidence: read.

table.name: Base Fuel Quantity Limit
table.scaling: g/rev air (at stock Injector Scaling 2918) uint16
table.description:
Ceiling on the base fuel quantity, the stoichiometric fuel the ECU calculates from measured air before any enrichment. Its meaning in air depends on Injector Scaling: stock it allows about 5 g of air per revolution, but lowering the injector flow figure (for example for E85) lowers the ceiling. Raise it in proportion when you raise Injector Scaling, or the engine will run lean at high airflow.
Details: When used: always while running (every pass of 0x0B7E00, which computes load and the base fuel quantity, read). Upper limit of the base (stoichiometric) fuel quantity FFF8ADEA. 0x0B8030 (read) computes FFF8ADEA = air quantity FFF8C250 x Injector Scaling x 0.10266 / 14.7 / 4 / rpm x 0.125 (= 0.5587 x Injector Scaling x air per cylinder per cycle in g) and stores min(that, this) (0x0B80FC-0x0B8112: MOVU.W @0x23696, CMP/GE, read). The limited value is what the rest of the fuel path uses: the base pulse 0x0D15EC (FFF8C05C = 16 x FFF8ADEA x trims), before the enrichment/fuel factor 0x0D1528 and the flow compensation and latency 0x0D2BB8; the transient-fuel film model 0x0F5F84; the fuel load FFF8ADEE (0x0B895C); and the fuel-used accumulators 0x06B70E (read). Above the limit the base pulse stops rising with airflow, so the mixture goes lean as air keeps rising; enrichment is applied on top of the limited value and does not lift it (inferred from the order of the calls). The raw unit includes Injector Scaling, so the limit in air terms moves with it: air per revolution at the limit = this x 3.580 / Injector Scaling (raw) g/rev = this x reference injector flow [g/s] x 0.0004704. Shown in g/rev for stock Injector Scaling 2918 (2.61 g/s). Stock 4060 = 4.98 g/rev (2.49 g per cylinder per cycle, about 556 g/s at 6700 rpm), well beyond the stock turbo. With Injector Scaling at 1.74 g/s (fuel added for E85 by lowering the flow figure) the limit drops to 3.32 g/rev; below about 1.73 g/s it falls under the 3.31 g/rev (256 %) ceiling of engine load FFF8ADE4 (0x0B7EFC, read) and becomes the first limit reached. When you raise Injector Scaling raw (lower reference flow), raise this in proportion: new = 4060 x new raw / 2918 keeps 4.98 g/rev (u16, up to 65535). On AT/CVT codings, while FFF886AB bit 5 is set (meaning not decoded), the value is first smoothed by boot filter 0x6CEC with cal 0x23694 (stock 255); the limit applies on either path (read). 4060 in all eight images; the same code in LF78001H 0x0C1770, LF79002P 0x0C83DC, LF79100P 0x0C788C, LF9C100P 0x0C0ED8, LV9N 0x0A6840 (read). LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 023696 by its caller in the decompiled code (read). Evidence: Base fuel quantity cap: the first-stage fuel quantity routine (counterpart of LF75404S 0x0B8030; LF79002P 0x0C83DC, LF79100P 0x0C788C, LF9C100P 0x0C0ED8, LF78001H 0x0C1770) stores min(quantity, this cal); stock 4060 as in LF75404S (read, my research notes). Address 02A94A. Confidence: read.

table.name: HPFP Integral Step
table.description:
How much the rail-pressure controller's integral term moves each 10 ms pass, toward removing a steady pressure error. Higher = faster correction, more risk of hunting. Stock 16.
Details: 0x164B3C (read): only in HPFP state FFF8AB35 = 3 the integrator FFF86A44 (added to the command as /16) steps down by this when target - actual >= HPFP Integral Threshold, up by this when actual - target >= the threshold, and holds while |target - actual| < the threshold; it is frozen while the command sits at its clamp, and limited to cal 0x3F346...0x3F344 (-19200...19200). Stock 16 (one command count per pass). p16 (read): 0x164B3C (<- 0x164804 <- 0x07C408) runs every 10 ms. LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 05EAD8 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 00DC14. Confidence: read.

table.name: HPFP Integral Threshold
Fuel Quantity (us (injector pulse, 0.3 MPa ref, incl. latency))
table.scaling: us (injector pulse 0.3 MPa ref incl. latency) uint16

table.description:
Deadband of the rail-pressure integrator, by fuel quantity (microseconds of injector pulse): while the pressure error is smaller than this, the integral term holds; beyond it, it steps toward removing the error. Larger = more steady error tolerated, less hunting. Stock 0.5 MPa flat.

table.name: HPFP Command Minimum
table.description:

table.name: HPFP Command Range

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling
table.description:
Base open-loop (power enrichment) AFR target by rpm and load, used once the exhaust temperature estimate is high enough. The ECU uses the richer of this and the Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV ..., AVCS ...) group: to lean, edit both; to richen, either. Also see Open Loop Fueling Floor (Outside Closed Loop).
Details: Note: the ECU has a second open-loop fuel path: the four "Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV ..., AVCS ...)" tables 05ABB0..05ABEC, blended by TGV and AVCS (0x0CE5E8 -> FFF8A681); 0x0CEA80 takes the richer of the two (max). To lean the open-loop target edit both sets; richening works with either (read, my research notes). Also see Open Loop Fueling Floor. Base open-loop enrichment target, 0x0CE854. Used only while the exhaust temperature estimate FFF8AFD0 (see Exhaust Temperature Model Map A/B) is >= cal 0x18DD4 (39322, hysteresis cal 0x18DD6 = 2185), or its integral FFF8C03C >= cal 0x18DD8 (65535); otherwise this path contributes 0 (read). While cal 0x2F79A bit 4 is clear (stock; the first argument of 0x0CE854), the additive term (Primary Open Loop Fueling Additive x DAM multiplier) is added, minus Primary Open Loop Fueling Subtractive x Primary Open Loop Fueling Subtractive DAM Multiplier(DAM)/128, both all zero in stock (read). The result is rate-limited (FFF84424) into FFF8A682, and FFF8A684 = max(FFF8A682, other enrichments) feeds commanded lambda. LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 05AC6C by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 009728. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV Closed, AVCS Inactive)
table.description:
Open-loop AFR target for TGVs closed with AVCS not in active control, part of a blend by TGV position and AVCS state, used above Open Loop Delay Load Threshold after a delay. Stock identical to Primary Open Loop Fueling; edit all five together. The ECU uses the richer of the two systems, so leaning needs both.
Details: When used: whenever the open-loop delay has expired (see below); the blend follows TGV position and AVCS state. TGV-closed base, weight 1 - a (AVCS not in active control). 0x0CE5E8 (read; called from 0x0C589C with rpm FFF8CD54, load FFF8A616, cal 0x2F79A bit 4, DAM FFF811AE, AVCS weight FFF8A743 and TGV open fraction FFF8B3E8): TGV-closed base = 05ABB0 x (255 - a)/255 + 05ABD8 x a/255, TGV-open base = 05ABC4 x (255 - a)/255 + 05ABEC x a/255, where a = FFF8A743 is the AVCS-active weight from 0x0D952C (255 while both cam controllers are in active control, my research notes); blend FFF8A69B = closed x (1 - FFF8B3E8) + open x FFF8B3E8. With cal 0x2F79A bit 4 clear (stock): FFF8A681 = clamp(blend + Additive x DAM Multiplier(DAM)/128 - 05AC14 x 05AC3C(DAM)/128 (Primary Open Loop Fueling Subtractive (TGV/AVCS Group) x its DAM multiplier; both all zero in stock), 0, 255). With the bit set: Alternate (+ cal 0x13DCD) while DAM16 < cal 0x1391C (16), else blend + cal 0x13DCD. 0x0CEA80 (read) then takes FFF8A681 (only once FFF8AFD6 >= FFF8AFE6, the open-loop delay, and when >= cal 0x13DD0 = 5), scales it by cal 0x237CA/128 (x1.0), rate-limits its rise by 05ACD4(rpm) and sets FFF8A684 = max(that, FFF8A682), FFF8A682 being Primary Open Loop Fueling from 0x0CE854. FFF8A684 is the open-loop enrichment in commanded lambda 256/(256 + B030 + A684 + AFE8) (0x171C88). So the commanded open-loop mixture is the richer of the two systems: to lean the target, lower this group as well as Primary Open Loop Fueling; to richen, raise this group (Primary Open Loop Fueling alone only takes effect while its exhaust-temperature enable holds: 0x0CE854 sets FFF8A683 to 0 unless FFF8AFD0 >= cal 0x18DD4 or FFF8C03C >= cal 0x18DD8, read). Details: When used: every pass of 0x0C8A28 while rpm FFF8CD54 <= cal 0x1CBD8 (4000 rpm) (read). 0x0C8A28 blends this table (weight FFF8B3E8, the TGV open fraction) with 05A220, both on rpm FFF8CD54 x coolant FFF88A44, and filters the blend toward the target with weight cal 0x23728 / 0x23729 (13/256 at coolant FFF8CD65 >= cal 0x2376E = 13 degC, else 179/256) through boot helper 0x6C70 into FFF8C534 / FFF842C4 (read). The filtered byte multiplies the secondary cranking pulse FFF8AFC4 (fuel modes 1/2) (255 = x1.0, inferred like the coolant multipliers). Cranking pulse (read, 0x0C8A28 / 0x0C9038): FFF842B4 = clamp(base x ramp x A67E x A687 x filtered RPM multiplier x coolant multiplier (x 05A1FC-or-64 in 0x0C8A28) x const, 0, 524280) x 0.125; the per-injector quantity is never below 10 x that (0x0D168C). Stock: identical to its TGV twin; 1.0 at 200 rpm and at coolant >= 20 degC, falling with rpm to 0.52 at 800 rpm when cold. Edit the TGV Closed / Open pair together unless a TGV-dependent value is wanted. LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 05A234 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 008780. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Cranking Fuel Secondary Low Rail Pressure Multiplier
table.description:
Multiplies the secondary cranking fuel by coolant when rail pressure is still low some time into a start (64 = x1.0). Stock x1.5 between -10 and 40 degC, otherwise x1.0.
Details: When used: while the low-rail-pressure start latch FFF8A856 bit 6 is set (0x0C8A28 argument from the call in 0x0C589C, read; the latch is set by 0x10B54C when rail pressure is still low after a calibrated time, my research notes). 0x0C8A28 multiplies the secondary cranking pulse FFF8AFC4 by this(coolant FFF8CD65 = degC + 50) instead of the fixed 64 (read), so 64 = x1.0. Stock 1.0, and 1.5 between -10 and 40 degC. Cranking pulse (read, 0x0C8A28 / 0x0C9038): FFF842B4 = clamp(base x ramp x A67E x A687 x filtered RPM multiplier x coolant multiplier (x 05A1FC-or-64 in 0x0C8A28) x const, 0, 524280) x 0.125; the per-injector quantity is never below 10 x that (0x0D168C). LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 05A1FC by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 008748. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Low Rail Pressure Start Enrichment
table.description:
Extra fuel by coolant when rail pressure is still low some time into a start, until pressure has stayed close to target for a while. Stock +50 % between -10 and 40 degC, otherwise 0.
Details: When used: while the low-rail-pressure start latch FFF8A856 bit 6 is set (0x10B54C, my research notes). 0x0CDD8C (read): FFF8B014 = this(coolant FFF8CD65 = degC + 50) until rail pressure FFF88884 has stayed at or above the rail target FFF8B9A0 minus cal 0x15194 (3279 counts, about 2 MPa) for cal 0x15196 (500) passes; then FFF8B014 ramps down by cal 0x15192 / 2 = 1 count (1/256 of fuel) per 20 ms pass (0x0CDD8C runs in the 20 ms task 0x0C73D0), so stock +50 % fades out over 128 passes = 2.6 s; the 500-pass hold is 10 s. It returns to the full table value whenever rail pressure drops below the threshold again (counter reset). FFF8B014 is added to FFF8B010 (see Running After-Start Enrichment 1). Unit 1/256 of fuel (inferred, same as FFF8B010). Stock 128 (+50 %) between -10 and 40 degC, else 0. LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 05AA48 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 009324. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Start Enrichment (Load, TGV Open)
table.description:
Start-path enrichment by load and coolant with the TGVs open, blended with the TGV Closed table by TGV position. Raising it adds fuel during start-up.
Details: FFF8B02C (0x0CEF04, read): Start Enrichment (Load, TGV Open) weighted by FFF8B3E8, Start Enrichment (Load, TGV Closed) by 1 - FFF8B3E8 and Start Enrichment (Load) RPM Multiplier; B02C adds to the start-path fuel factor (B012 + A828 + B02C)/256 + 0.5 used by fuel modes 0 and 3 (0x0D1400, read). Unit 1/256 of base fuel (inferred). Blend weight FFF8B3E8 is the TGV position weight from 0x10C948: average of the two TGV position sensors FFF88AA6/88AA8 through 05D29C/05D290, ramped (cal 0x379EC/0x379EE) and gated by FFF8A881 bit 4 and FFF88E2A bit 5 (read). TGV polarity (read): 0x0D952C blends its Closed and Open ignition sets as Closed x (1 - FFF8B3E8) + Open x FFF8B3E8, so FFF8B3E8 is the TGV open fraction; 0x10C948 drives it toward 0 while FFF8A881 bit 4 is set, so that bit set = TGVs closed. table.name: Start Enrichment Additive (Load, TGV Closed)
table.description:
Extra start enrichment by load and coolant, added on top of Start Enrichment (Load) only while a start condition flag is set (depends on start coolant, pedal and speed; not fully decoded). TGVs closed side of a TGV blend. Stock equal to the TGV Open table below 50 degC.
Details: When used: only while FFF8A857 bit 7 is set (set by 0x10BF88 only when FFF8A852 = 2, the second-pulse share FFF8A85F = 0 and a computed quantity is below FFF8B088 + cal 0x2A3CC; cal 0x2996C bit 3, coolant, the pedal-released flag and vehicle speed only pick the share table used in that computation; meaning inferred). 0x0CF0F4 (read): FFF8B02E = 05AD58(load FFF8A616, coolant FFF88A44) x FFF8B3E8 + 05AD44 x (1 - FFF8B3E8) x 05AD6C(rpm)/128 (this table weighted by 1 - FFF8B3E8, the TGV open fraction); 0x0CEF04 adds FFF8B02E to Start Enrichment (Load) FFF8B02C under the same bit (read). Stock: the two tables are equal below 50 degC coolant; at 50 degC and above the TGV Open table is 0. LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 05AD44 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 009800. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Start Enrichment (Coolant Window Override)
table.description:
Replaces Start Enrichment (Load) for a while after start, but only when the start coolant falls inside a calibrated window. That window is empty in stock, so practically never used.
Details: When used: only when coolant at start FFF88A46 lies within cal 0x11D24...0x11D26 (both 0 in stock: -40 degC, practically never). 0x0CEF04 (read): in fuel states 2/3 FFF8B02C = this(coolant FFF88A44) instead of the Start Enrichment (Load) blend until the accelerator has been pressed for cal 0x11D02 (40) passes within the first cal 0x11D00 (800) counts of FFF8B06A (passes since running); the output may move by at most cal 0x11D38 (65535 = unlimited) per pass. FFF8B02C (0x0CEF04) adds to the start-path fuel factor (B012 + A828 + B02C)/256 + 0.5 of fuel modes 0 and 3 (0x0D1400, read). Stock data identical to Warm-Up Enrichment (Coolant Window Override). LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 05AD04 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 0097C0. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Running After-Start Enrichment 1 (First Start)
table.description:

table.name: Start History Reset Delay (Coolant)
table.description:
Time after ignition-off, by coolant, after which the ECU forgets the previous start, so the next start counts as a first start rather than a restart. Shorter with a weak battery. Stock 1500 counts up to 40 degC, 50 above.
Details: When used: 0x0D39DC with 0x0D3A74 (read; my research notes): after the ignition is switched off (FFF8A65A bit 5) a counter runs; when it reaches this(coolant FFF88A44) (or cal 0x13E5E = 50 while battery FFF88A7E < cal 0x13E60, 11.0 V) FFF8A65A bit 6 is set, which clears the start history FFF811A7 bits 2-5/7 and FFF81408 used for the restart start type FFF8A6E7. Stock 1500 counts up to 40 C, 50 above. LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 05B270 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 009E2C. Confidence: read.

table.name: Injection Timing (Single Injection)

Main injection angle FFF8B052 in running mode (FFF8906B = 3) after a start delay (counter FFF84480 >= cal 0x12008) (0x0CFE8C, read): this table, plus Injection Timing Additive x multiplier / 255 when the high-pedal latch FFF8A8A4 bit 6 is clear (with FFF88E28 bit 2 or FFF88E2B bit 5 set: this table alone), clamped to 360..1079 code units (half degrees) (read). LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 05B020 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 009B7C. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Injection Timing (High Pedal)
table.description:
Injection angle used instead of Injection Timing (Single Injection) and its additive while the pedal is at 90 % or more (released below 85 %). Stock 260-360 BTDC: early intake stroke.
Details: Units (FU_UNITS): degrees BTDC of the compression TDC (display 720 - x/2; 0x0CFE8C clamps the code to 360-1079 = 180.5-540 BTDC, read); larger = earlier. Stock 260-360 BTDC: early intake stroke. When used: replaces Injection Timing (Single Injection) + additive while FFF8A8A4 bit 6 is set, a high-pedal latch built like bit 7 (set at >= 90 % pedal, cleared below 85 %; 0x11C0C4 / 0x10F608, read), and only while FFF88E28 bit 2 and FFF88E2B bit 5 are clear (0x0CFE8C, read). Stock table 15-40 degrees later at 1600-4000 rpm and 1.29-2.07 g/rev, but the stock multiplier is 0 except at hot intake air (95 F and up) with a high value of its unidentified row input, so it is mostly inactive in stock.

table.name: Cranking Injection Timing
table.description:
Injection angle while cranking and for the first 0.3 s of running, by rpm and coolant, but only when the engine is in normal combustion mode (fuel mode 1): after about 10 s of cranking, when the low-rail-pressure start latch is set, or on a re-crank before the start sequence reset. A normal start uses Start Injection Angle (Fuel Mode 0) instead. Stock 245 BTDC everywhere (intake stroke).
Details: Units (FU_UNITS): degrees BTDC of the compression TDC (display 720 - x/2; 0x0CFE8C clamps the code to 360-1079 = 180.5-540 BTDC, read); larger = earlier. Stock 245 BTDC everywhere (intake stroke). When used: 0x0CFE8C (read) writes this table into FFF8B052 while cranking (FFF8906B = 2) and for the first cal 0x12008 (30 passes, 0.3 s) after the engine is running. FFF8B052 is the injection angle only for injectors in fuel mode 1 (0x0CB394, read). A normal start cranks in combustion mode 0 = fuel mode 0 (init 0, 0x109B4C; 0x108B08, read), where the angle is FFF8B050 = Start Injection Angle (Fuel Mode 0) (05AF80, 0x0CFB28 / 0x0CB394, read), so this table does not set the normal cranking angle. It applies when the crank runs in combustion mode 4 / fuel mode 1: after about 10 s of continuous cranking (cal 0x29A32 = 1000 passes, 0x109B4C), when the low-rail-pressure start latch FFF8A856 bit 6 forces mode 4, or on a re-crank before the mode returned to 0 (read). Columns are coolant temperature FFF88A44 (passed by 0x0C589C, read; breakpoints -30..80 C). Replaced by Cranking Injection Timing (Stop-Start Restart) when FFF89066 bit 0 is set; a fixed cal 0x11FE6 overrides it when cal 0x38448 bit 6 is set (clear in stock). LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 05B040 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 009BB0. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Start Injection Angle (Fuel Mode 0)
table.description:
Injection angle in the first phase after start, by rpm and coolant: a compression-stroke injection, probably for the stratified start. Kept within 0.5-180 BTDC. Stock 160 BTDC when very cold, otherwise 80-116 BTDC.
Details: Units (FU_UNITS): degrees BTDC of the injected cylinder's compression TDC (0 = firing TDC, 180 = intake BDC (start of compression), 360 = gas-exchange TDC, 540 = expansion BDC); larger = earlier. Same scale as every Injection Timing table. Clamped to 0.5-180 BTDC (code 1080-1439, 0x0CFB28, read). Stock 160 BTDC in the two coldest columns, otherwise 80 BTDC at 200 rpm to 116.5 BTDC at 900 rpm: a compression-stroke injection for the first phase after start (inferred stratified start). Injections cannot start in the last 10 degrees before TDC: 0.5-10 BTDC act as 10.5 BTDC (0x1DCA04, read). When used: fuel mode 0 (combustion mode 0, the first phase after start, 0x108B08). 0x0CFB28 (read): in fuel states 2/3 FFF8B050 = this(rpm/50 FFF8CD56, coolant FFF88A44) clamped to 1080...1439; else 0x636. In cranking with FFF89066 bit 0 set it is replaced by 05AF74/05AF68 (coolant) by rail pressure FFF88884 vs cal 0x2A65E; with cal 0x38448 bit 7 set the fixed cal 0x11EBC is used. 0x0CB394 and its three siblings (one per injector) use FFF8B050 - 1080 as the injection angle when that injector's fuel mode FFF8A858.. is 0 (read). table.name: Base Timing (EGR Off, TGV Open)
table.description:
Base (upper-limit) ignition timing map for pedal pressed, EGR off and TGVs open, which covers wide-open throttle and high rpm. The result is rate-limited (cals 0x1058C / 0x1058E) and the IAT and coolant compensations FFF8A782 + FFF8A787 are added (0x0C2C08) to give base timing FFF8A645, which is the upper limit of the fired base timing, not a value fired as is: 0x0DD568 sets FFF8A76A = FFF8A645 - Torque Reduction Spark Retard(max(FFF8A64B, 102) x 128) - tip-in retard, and FFF8A64B carries the request efficiency FFF8AF22 (0x0C13B4 / 0x0C39DC), so in effect FFF8A76A = min(FFF8A645, Primary Ignition request + KCA + FLKC) less any torque-reduction retard (Torque Reduction Spark Retard is the inverse of Ignition Efficiency vs Retard; min() form computed). FFF8A76A then goes through the rate limiter 0x0DD760, the base sum FFF8A74B (0x0DA600) and the fired sum 0x0D9E40 (FBKC and the retard terms) to FFF8A744 (read). In limit states FFF8A639 = 0x0B/0x0C/0x19/0x1A/0x1B the spark target FFF8A72A replaces FFF8A645 (read). table.name: Minimum Ignition Timing (Coolant)
table.description:

table.name: Ignition Dwell Time

table.name: Knock Correction Advance Max A (TGV Open)
table.description:
First part of the knock correction advance (timing added as DAM rises), by rpm and load, for TGVs open; blended with the TGV Closed table and scaled by KCA DAM Curve A. It is added to the Primary Ignition request, not to the Base Timing map: the ECU fires the lower of Base Timing and Primary + knock advance + fine learning, so raising it adds timing only where that sum is still below Base Timing (at high load in stock it is). Stock up to about 7.7 degrees.
Details: Knock correction advance (0x0E71FC and 0x0E1FD8, read). Two components, A and B, are each looked up by rpm (FFF8CD54) x load (FFF8ADE4) and blended by the TGV open fraction v = FFF8B3E8: A = 05C078 x (1 - v) + 05C08C x v (FFF8A7A4), B = 05C0A0 x (1 - v) + 05C0B4 x v (FFF8A7A6), and the maximum FFF8A7A5 = A + B (capped at 255). With cal 0x35509 bit 0 set (it is, in both images) the applied advance FFF8A791 = (A x KCA DAM Curve A(DAM) + B x KCA DAM Curve B(DAM)) / 128; otherwise it is A7A5 x DAM / 16. One count = 0.3516 degrees (x 180 >> 8 in 0x0C13B4 / 0x0DB3D4, x 90 / 128 in 0x0D9088, read). Where it goes (read, knock routing review 2026-10-31): FFF8A791 is not a term of the fired-timing sum 0x0D9E40 (FBKC FFF8A79A is the only knock term there). It reaches the coil through the timing request: 0x0C13B4 (combustion modes FFF8A85C = 3/4, i.e. normal running) forms the request retard r = max(0, FFF8A645 - (FFF8A789 - 32 + (FFF8A791 + FLKC FFF8A7A7) x 180 / 256)) and FFF8AF22 = Ignition Efficiency vs Retard(r); 0x0C39DC folds AF22 (times the torque-cap ratio) into FFF8A64B, and 0x0DD568 sets the spark angle FFF8A76A = FFF8A645 - Torque Reduction Spark Retard(max(A64B, 102) x 128) - tip-in retard (AF22 >> 7 directly with the pedal released or a cylinder cut active). Torque Reduction Spark Retard is the exact inverse of Ignition Efficiency vs Retard, so in effect FFF8A76A = min(base timing FFF8A645, timing request + KCA + FLKC) less any torque-reduction retard; it then rate-limits (0x0DD760) into the base sum FFF8A74B (0x0DA600) and the fired timing FFF8A744 (min() form computed from the inverse tables). In limit states FFF8A639 = 0x0B/0x0C/0x19/0x1A/0x1B the spark target FFF8A72A (0x0D9088: request + 0.3516 deg x (A791 + A7A7) with the pedal pressed) replaces FFF8A645 outright. The total FFF8A77B (0x0DFA88) has one reader, 0x0DDBBC, whose output FFF8A770 is 0 in stock (05BB24 / 05BB38 all zero), and the headroom term of 0x0DB3D4 (A7A5 - A791 into FFF8A754) is capped at cal 0x2FEC2 = 0. So the advance is fired only where Primary Ignition (+ compensations + EGR Timing Advance) + KCA + FLKC is below the Base Timing map; it can never lift the fired timing above Base Timing. In stock at high load that is the normal case (e.g. 4000 rpm / 160 %, TGVs open: Primary Ignition 3 degrees, Base Timing 21 degrees, so full-DAM KCA of about 6.7 degrees fires almost degree for degree; computed). Component A, TGVs open (weight v). Stock up to 22 counts = 7.7 degrees. LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 05C08C by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 00AD60. Confidence: read.

table.name: FBKC Window RPM Maximum
table.description:
Upper rpm limit for feedback knock correction. Above it the current knock retard is held: no new retard and no recovery. Stock 6,400 rpm, below the 6,700 rpm rev limit, so knock correction freezes near the limiter. Raise this if you raise the rev limit.
Details: 0x0E8128 / 0x0E2F94 (read): upper end of the FBKC working range. While rpm FFF8CE9C is above this (with hysteresis cal 0x1C27C), FFF8A7AE is clear and FBKC goes to state 5, which holds the current correction (x cal 0x1C26E / 128 = 1.0): no new knock retard and no recovery. Inside the window (FBKC Window RPM Minimum...this, and FFF8A7AF set) the knock retard states 0x0D/0x0E, the hold state 0x10 (no knock, fewer than 100 events since the last knock) and the recovery state 0x0F are used. Stock 32768 = 6,400 rpm, below the 6,700 rpm rev limit, so FBKC is frozen near the limiter. LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 01C27A by the code that reads it (read). Address 0227AA. Confidence: read.

table.name: FBKC Window RPM Minimum
table.description:
Lower rpm limit for feedback knock correction: below it no new knock retard is taken, and any existing knock retard is given back by FBKC Recovery Step each combustion event. Stock 1,200 rpm.
Details: Lower end of the FBKC working range: below it no knock retard or recovery steps are taken (see FBKC Window RPM Maximum). 0x0E2BE4 (read): the second window flag is true while rpm FFF8CE9C >= this (once true, it stays until rpm < this - 0x1C286). Stock 6144 = 1,200 rpm. LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 01C284 by the code that reads it (read). Address 0227B4. Confidence: read.

table.name: DAM Step Gain (FLKC Cell)
FLKC Cell (FLKC cell (5 x rpm range + load range))
table.scaling: FLKC cell (5 x rpm range load range) uint8

table.description:
How strongly each fine-knock-learning step moves DAM, per FLKC learning cell (index = 5 x rpm range + load range, 0-34; index 0 is the lowest rpm and load cell). Larger values make DAM move faster when the ECU learns knock in that cell; 0 means that cell never moves DAM. Stock non-zero only at indices 1-3, 6-8 and 11-13 (below 7200 rpm, loads 0.41-3.19 g/rev); 0 in the lowest load range. Purpose is inferred.
Details: When used: every combustion event while the DAM state FFF8A7AA is 8 (0x0E7AEC: FFF8A7CF set and no other state applies, read). 0x0E792C (read): DAM x 256 += this(FLKC cell FFF8A790) x FFF8A799 x 90 >> 16, clamped 0..256 (DAM 0..1); FFF8A799 is the signed step chosen by the FLKC state (-23/-24/-14 in states 8/9/10, +6/+3 in states 5/6, 0x0E2ABC). So DAM moves by this x step count; a larger value makes DAM react more to learning in that cell. Index = FLKC cell FFF8A790 = 5 x rpm range + load range, 0..34 (0x0E1C58, read; 0x0E1F90 reads the learned value FFF81414[A790]), so index 0 is the lowest rpm / lowest load cell and is used. Stock (DAM per step count) 0.0044/0.0048/0.0060 at indices 1-3 (below 2400 rpm; load ranges 0.41-0.93 / 0.93-1.70 / 1.70-3.19 g/rev = 31.5-71.5 / 71.5-131.5 / 131.5-246.5 %), 0.0067/0.0051/0.0058 at 6-8 (2400-4400 rpm, same load ranges), 0.0055/0.0089/0.0105 at 11-13 (4400-7200 rpm); 0 elsewhere, including the lowest load range (indices 0/5/10, at or below 0.41 g/rev) and the top load range (4/9/14, above 3.19 g/rev). With the -23 step of state 8 that is -0.10..-0.24 DAM per step (computed). LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 05C1A4 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 00AE78. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: FLKC Advance Learning Inhibit Zones
zone index (5 x rpm band + load band)
table.scaling: zone index (5 x rpm band load band) uint8

table.description:
Per rpm/load zone switch: 1 stops fine knock learning from learning timing back upward there, so it can only learn retard (inferred). Stock 1 in the high-load, low-to-mid rpm area (2100-4300 rpm at higher loads). These zones use their own rpm/load boundaries, not the FLKC cell boundaries.
Details: When used: every combustion event (0x0E74B0 <- 0x0E402C <- 0x07D0E0, crank task, read). Zone index FFF8A7A8 = 5 x rpm band + load band: rpm bands <=2100, 2100-3000, 3000-3400, 3400-3800, 3800-4300, 4300-8000, >8000 rpm (FFF8CE9C, cals 0x26FBC..0x26FC6, hysteresis cal 0x26FC8 = 50 rpm); load bands <=1.42, 1.42-1.68, 1.68-1.94, 1.94-2.20, >2.20 g/rev (<=110, 110-130, 130-150, 150-170, >170 %) (FFF8ADE4, cals 0x26FB2..0x26FB8, hysteresis cal 0x26FBA = 2.5 %) (read). FFF8A7A9 = this(zone). With 1 the fine-learning state machine 0x0E1A38 cannot enter states 4-7, which include the positive learning steps (FFF8A799 = +cal 0x1C269 / 0x1C268 in states 5/6, 0x0E2ABC), and 0x0E9970 sets the latch FFF8A7D0 (read). So in the flagged zones FLKC learns only downward (inferred from the step signs). Stock 1 in zones 6-9 (2100-3000 rpm above 110 %), 12-14 (3000-3400 above 130 %), 18-19 (3400-3800 above 150 %) and 24 (3800-4300 above 170 %): the high-load, low-to-mid rpm area. Zone boundaries differ from the FLKC cell boundaries. LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 05C0F8 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 00ADCC. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: FLKC Range Boundary Load 1
table.description:
One of the four load boundaries that split fine learning knock correction (FLKC) into load ranges; each learning cell covers one rpm range by one load range. Moving it changes which conditions share a learned correction. Stock boundaries are 0.41 / 0.92 / 1.70 / 3.19 g/rev (31.5 / 71.5 / 131.5 / 246.5 % load) (this is boundary 1, stock 31.5 %). Keep them in increasing order.
Details: Fine learning knock correction cells (0x0E1C58, read): the cell FFF8A790 = 5 x rpm range + load range (0...34). Seven rpm ranges are split at the six boundaries 0x1C24A...0x1C254 on FFF8CE9C, five load ranges at the four boundaries 0x1C240...0x1C246 on FFF8ADE4, each with a hysteresis band (0x1C256 rpm, 0x1C248 load). The learned value for the cell is FFF81414[cell] (s16, x 256); 0x0E73CC applies FFF8A7A7 = min(that, KCA Max x (16 - DAM) x 16) / 256, in 0.3516 degree counts; it is not added to the fired timing directly: like KCA it enters the timing request (0x0C13B4 -> FFF8AF22 -> 0x0C39DC / 0x0DD568), so fired base timing = min(Base Timing + comps, request + KCA + FLKC), and in limit states 0x0B/0x0C/0x19/0x1A/0x1B through the spark target FFF8A72A (0x0D9088). 0x0DFA88 also sums it into the total knock correction FFF8A77B, whose only consumer (0x0DDBBC -> FFF8A770) is zero in stock (read). A negative learned value therefore retards the spark only where the request side is the lower one (most of the high-load map in stock); where Base Timing is lower it is hidden until it pulls the request below Base Timing. Feedback knock correction is the only knock term added directly (0x0D9E40). load boundary. Stock 0.41 / 0.92 / 1.70 / 3.19 g/rev (31.5 / 71.5 / 131.5 / 246.5 % load). LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 01C240 by the code that reads it (read). Address 022770. Confidence: read.

table.name: FBKC Retard Step (Secondary Knock, State 0x0D, Unused in Stock)
table.description:
Timing pulled per event by feedback knock correction when the secondary knock detector fires. Unused in stock because every Secondary Knock Threshold is at maximum, so that detector never triggers. Stock about 1.4 degrees.
Details: Feedback knock correction (0x0E2BE4, read): FFF8A79A is an s8 integrator kept at or below 0 and added directly to the fired timing (x 0.3516 degrees, 0x0D9E40): it is the only knock term of that sum, and FFF8A79A is one value for the whole engine, so a knock event on any cylinder retards all four (the fired timing FFF8A744 is recomputed per event for the next cylinder, but no per-cylinder knock retard exists; read). The state FFF8A79C (set once per combustion event by 0x0E2F94 from that event's knock results FFF8A7AD / FFF8A7B5; FFF8A7C1 is the knock-window-length flag (1 = extended window), used there only to reload per-cylinder hold counters FFF84920...FFF84930 from cal 0x27014 when it changes, purpose inferred) picks the action: states 0x0E, 0x0D, 7 and 6 subtract a step (floor = minus FBKC Maximum Retard); states 0x0C, 2, 0 (outside the rpm window) and the other non-knock states (0x0A outside the window, 0x0B) add the recovery step 0x1C271; 0x10 (inside the rpm window, no knock, fewer than cal 0x1C288 = 100 events since the last knock) holds the correction unchanged; 0x0F (inside the window, no knock, >= 100 events) adds 0x1C270, 8/9 add 0x1C272 (capped at 0); 5 = FFF8A79B x 0x1C26E / 128; 3 and 4 load the fixed values 0x1C26F / 0x1C278; 1 = 0. States (0x0E2F94, read, in priority order): 1 = knock control off (cal 0x56EE7 bit 7); 2 = FFF886AB bit 5 or load FFF8ADE4 <= cal 0x1C27E (0); 3 / 4 = FFF88E29 bit 3 / FFF88E2A bit 6 (fixed -14 counts = -4.9 degrees, inferred knock-sensor fault default); 5 = engine speed above FBKC Window RPM Maximum (hold); inside the rpm window: 6 / 0x0D = knock A (FFF8A7AD, intensity > Secondary Knock Threshold, never in stock) with / without FFF8AA85 bit 0, 7 / 0x0E = knock B (FFF8A7B5, intensity > Knock Threshold, the active one); 0x0F = no knock and FFF8B130 (events since the last knock, 0x0E7C7C) >= cal 0x1C288 (100), 0x10 = no knock, fewer events; 8 / 9 hold; 0x0A / 0x0B / 0x0C other conditions (0x0B: A/F FFF88AF6 above a lambda threshold). Subtracted per pass in state 0x0D. Stock 4 counts = 1.41 degrees. p16 (read): the FBKC logic 0x0E2F94 (0x0E402C <- 0x07D0E0 <- 0x1E1CBC) is crank-synchronous: one pass per combustion event (180 deg CA, dispatched at tooth position 70 via the ATU-J0 software interrupt 0x0A7390), not per time. LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 01C277 by its caller in the decompiled code (read). Evidence: (read) Counterpart reader(s) 0x0E2BE4->0x0EDC08 (ref 1 access(es), target 1, size [1]); decompile token alignment puts this cal at the position of LF75404S 0x01C277 (1 reference(s), votes {'0227A7': 1}); machine-code effective addresses of the target function confirm 0x0227A7 is accessed as u8. Stock 4 (LF75404S 4). Matches the layout address. Address 0227A7. Confidence: read.

table.name: FLKC Counted-Cell Learned Value Threshold (Off in Stock)
table.description:
By DAM: a fine-knock-learning cell is counted when its learned value is at or above this, and the count sets an internal flag. It has no effect on a stock car because the flag is only used in a DAM range that DAM can never reach. Stock 3.87 degrees at low DAM down to 0.35 near full DAM.
Details: When used: computed every pass of 0x0E3DF4 (10 ms task), but without effect in stock. 0x0E7DF8 (read): one cell per pass, it counts the FLKC cells whose flag FFF811AF[cell] is 1 and whose learned value FFF81414[cell] is at or above this(DAM FFF811AE); after all 35 cells the count goes to FFF8A792 and FFF8A7A3 bit 1 = count >= cal 0x1C699 (4). 0x0E7D0C (read) uses that bit only together with DAM inside cal 0x1C698..0x1C697 (32..48 in DAM x 16 units), which DAM (0..16) never reaches, so the bit has no effect in stock. Stock 3.87 degrees at DAM 1/16 down to 0.35 degrees at 15/16. LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 05C1B0 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 00AE84. Confidence: read.

table.name: Base Timing DAM Blend Alternate (DAM 0) (Off in Stock)
table.description:
Alternate DAM-blended timing offset (DAM 0 side) for base timing. It has no effect on a stock car: it is only used when a calibration switch is set to a specific value, which it is not in stock. 32 = no change. Stock +2 degrees at low rpm, varying to 0 from 4000 rpm; identical to its DAM 1 pair.
Details: When used: never in stock. FFF8A73E/A73F have no other readers. So in stock neither table changes timing or any other output. With cal 0x32DEA = 'Z' the base timing term FFF8A73C would ramp toward A740 (cal 0x32DEC per pass) and enter the base timing sum FFF8A74B (0x0DA600). Stock flat across load and varying with rpm: 36 (+2 degrees) at 400-1200 rpm, 32 (no change) at 1600, 34 (+1) at 2000-2400, 36 (+2) at 2800-3600 rpm and 32 (no change) from 4000 rpm; identical to 05B560. The consumers match by use: FFF8A73F / FFF8BB6A are used once (with FFF8A73B-type term), FFF8A741 / FFF8BB6C twice (x0x32 and with the FFF8A738-type term) (read). So 0x0E54DC = Alternate (0x0D9BD4) and 0x0E5628 = Blend B (0x0D9D48). Phase 18 had put the Alternate entries on the Blend B reader's tables (00A204/00A1F0), now shared with the Phase 19 Blend B entries (port_sanity duplicate); stock data equal LF75404S 05B54C/05B560 (read). Descriptor 00A1C8. Confidence: read.

table.name: Knock Threshold (Event 1, Full Window)
table.scaling: knock ratio sum (3 strongest channels) uint16
table.description:
Knock intensity (sum of the three strongest knock-channel ratios to their background, 3.0 = all at background) (by rpm and load) above which a knock event in slot 1 counts as knock and triggers feedback knock retard; used while the extended (full) knock window is in use. Higher = less sensitive. Warning: the Full / Short Window sets were renamed on 2026-10-30 (earlier names had them swapped). Which cylinder slot 1 is has not been mapped.
Details: Knock decision (0x0E8654 / 0x0E80B4, read): for the event slot FFF8CDC0 (1-4) the knock intensity FFF8C1C0[slot] (output of the signal processing 0x0E51E4) is compared with two thresholds. Knock B, FFF8A7B5 = intensity > Knock Threshold (this family, FFF8C1CC[slot] by 0x0E77E0) or FFF8CDC4[slot] >= cal 0x1BD92 (65535, off); this is the active path in stock and drives FBKC states 7 / 0x0E (retard 0x1C275 / 0x1C274, 4 counts = 1.41 degrees). Knock A, FFF8A7AD = intensity > Secondary Knock Threshold (FFF8C1D4[slot] by 0x0E78E4); all 65535 in stock, so it never fires (states 6 / 0x0D). Each event also sets bits of FFF8A79D (0x10/0x20/0x30/0x40 by slot). Slot vs cylinder number not mapped. Knock Threshold (0x0E77E0, read): looked up by rpm FFF8CDC2 (x 31.25 + 500) and load FFF8A616 for each event slot; set A (05C104/118/12C/140) while FFF8A7C1 = 0, i.e. the nominal (short) window; set B (05C154/168/17C/190) while A7C1 = 1, i.e. the extended window (0x0E77E0 at 0x0E7836-0x0E784A; flag polarity read in 0x0E20E0 at 0x0E21AA-0x0E21EC; corrected 2026-10-30, the earlier names had the two sets swapped). A higher value needs a larger knock signal to count as knock (less sensitive). Set B (extended / full window). LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 05C154 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 00AE28. Confidence: read.

Knock intensity (sum of the three strongest knock-channel ratios to their background, 3.0 = all at background) (by rpm and load) above which a knock event in slot 3 counts as knock and triggers feedback knock retard; used while the extended (full) knock window is in use. Higher = less sensitive. Warning: the Full / Short Window sets were renamed on 2026-10-30 (earlier names had them swapped). Which cylinder slot 3 is has not been mapped.
Details: Knock decision (0x0E8654 / 0x0E80B4, read): for the event slot FFF8CDC0 (1-4) the knock intensity FFF8C1C0[slot] (output of the signal processing 0x0E51E4) is compared with two thresholds. Knock B, FFF8A7B5 = intensity > Knock Threshold (this family, FFF8C1CC[slot] by 0x0E77E0) or FFF8CDC4[slot] >= cal 0x1BD92 (65535, off); this is the active path in stock and drives FBKC states 7 / 0x0E (retard 0x1C275 / 0x1C274, 4 counts = 1.41 degrees). Knock A, FFF8A7AD = intensity > Secondary Knock Threshold (FFF8C1D4[slot] by 0x0E78E4); all 65535 in stock, so it never fires (states 6 / 0x0D). Each event also sets bits of FFF8A79D (0x10/0x20/0x30/0x40 by slot). Slot vs cylinder number not mapped. Knock Threshold (0x0E77E0, read): looked up by rpm FFF8CDC2 (x 31.25 + 500) and load FFF8A616 for each event slot; set A (05C104/118/12C/140) while FFF8A7C1 = 0, i.e. the nominal (short) window; set B (05C154/168/17C/190) while A7C1 = 1, i.e. the extended window (0x0E77E0 at 0x0E7836-0x0E784A; flag polarity read in 0x0E20E0 at 0x0E21AA-0x0E21EC; corrected 2026-10-30, the earlier names had the two sets swapped). A higher value needs a larger knock signal to count as knock (less sensitive). Set B (extended / full window). LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 05C17C by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 00AE50. Confidence: read.

table.name: Secondary Knock Threshold (Event 1)
table.scaling: knock ratio sum (3 strongest channels) uint16
table.description:
Second knock detector level by rpm for event slot 1; a signal above it triggers the secondary knock retard steps. Stock is at maximum everywhere, so it never fires and has no effect on a stock car. Unit: sum of the three strongest knock-channel ratios to their background (3.0 = all at background).
Details: Knock decision (0x0E8654 / 0x0E80B4, read): for the event slot FFF8CDC0 (1-4) the knock intensity FFF8C1C0[slot] (output of the signal processing 0x0E51E4) is compared with two thresholds. Knock B, FFF8A7B5 = intensity > Knock Threshold (this family, FFF8C1CC[slot] by 0x0E77E0) or FFF8CDC4[slot] >= cal 0x1BD92 (65535, off); this is the active path in stock and drives FBKC states 7 / 0x0E (retard 0x1C275 / 0x1C274, 4 counts = 1.41 degrees). Knock A, FFF8A7AD = intensity > Secondary Knock Threshold (FFF8C1D4[slot] by 0x0E78E4); all 65535 in stock, so it never fires (states 6 / 0x0D). Each event also sets bits of FFF8A79D (0x10/0x20/0x30/0x40 by slot). Slot vs cylinder number not mapped. 0x0E78E4 looks this 16-point curve up by FFF8CDC2 with the implicit-axis routine 0x7304 (0...240 in steps of 16 = 500...8,000 rpm, read). 65535 = never in stock. LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 01C5A2 by the calibration block offset of its neighbours (inferred). Data at 022AD2. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Knock Window Start
table.description:
Crank angle (probably degrees after top dead centre) at which the ECU starts listening for knock, by rpm; limited by Knock Window Start Minimum and Maximum. Stock 10 degrees at 500-1000 rpm and 20 at 1500-2000 rpm, dipping to 15-17.5 degrees at 2500-3500 rpm, then rising from 20 at 4000 rpm to 35 degrees from 7000 rpm.
Details: Knock window (0x0E2090 / 0x0E20E0, read): window start FFF8B118 = clamp(Knock Window Start(rpm), 0x1C210...0x1C212); nominal length FFF8B11C = Knock Window Length(rpm). The length used, FFF8B11A, is the nominal length plus Knock Window Length Extension only while timing FFF8A744 is at or below Knock Window Extension Timing Threshold (with hysteresis; MOVRT at 0x0E216E) and the extended window end (0x0E20E0 computes it from nominal + extension with the same formula 0x0E7CB0 uses for the window end FFF8A7AB) ends before the per-event angle FFF8C0E8 (built by 0x0E39C0 from FFF88860/FFF81478, inferred to be the next spark); if either fails the nominal length is used. Either way the length used is clamped to Knock Window Length Minimum...Maximum (0x1C1EC...0x1C1EE; 0x0E211E-0x0E2130 for the extended length, 0x0E21C0-0x0E21E8 for the nominal one, read). FFF8A7C1 / FFF8A7C2...C5 = 1 while the extended length is used (read, 0x0E20E0 at 0x0E21AA-0x0E21EC; corrected 2026-10-30). 0x0E7C00 / 0x0E7C24 scale start and length by FFF8CD46 into FFF8B12A / FFF8B12C for the window timer (1E5202, read). The rpm axis is FFF8CDC2 (rpm = x x 31.25 + 500, read). Degrees are crank degrees after the firing cylinder's TDC (reference inferred). Stock (05BDE0, x 180 / 65536): 10 degrees at 500-1000 rpm, 20 at 1500-2000, dipping to 17.5 at 2500, 15 at 3000 and 17.5 at 3500 rpm, back to 20 at 4000, then 22.5 at 4500 rising by 2.5 per 500 rpm to 35 degrees from 7000 rpm. The clamp 0x1C210...0x1C212 (0...79.9 degrees) does not bite on the stock values (read). LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 05BDE0 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 00AAB4. Confidence: read.

table.name: Knock Window Length
table.description:
Normal length of the knock listening window in crank degrees, by rpm; Knock Window Length Extension may be added at low timing. Stock 20 degrees below about 2000 rpm, 25 degrees above 2500 rpm.
Details: Knock window (0x0E2090 / 0x0E20E0, read): window start FFF8B118 = clamp(Knock Window Start(rpm), 0x1C210...0x1C212); nominal length FFF8B11C = Knock Window Length(rpm). The length used, FFF8B11A, is the nominal length plus Knock Window Length Extension only while timing FFF8A744 is at or below Knock Window Extension Timing Threshold (with hysteresis; MOVRT at 0x0E216E) and the extended window end (0x0E20E0 computes it from nominal + extension with the same formula 0x0E7CB0 uses for the window end FFF8A7AB) ends before the per-event angle FFF8C0E8 (built by 0x0E39C0 from FFF88860/FFF81478, inferred to be the next spark); if either fails the nominal length is used. Either way the length used is clamped to Knock Window Length Minimum...Maximum (0x1C1EC...0x1C1EE; 0x0E211E-0x0E2130 for the extended length, 0x0E21C0-0x0E21E8 for the nominal one, read). FFF8A7C1 / FFF8A7C2...C5 = 1 while the extended length is used (read, 0x0E20E0 at 0x0E21AA-0x0E21EC; corrected 2026-10-30). 0x0E7C00 / 0x0E7C24 scale start and length by FFF8CD46 into FFF8B12A / FFF8B12C for the window timer (1E5202, read). The rpm axis is FFF8CDC2 (rpm = x x 31.25 + 500, read). Degrees are crank degrees after the firing cylinder's TDC (reference inferred). Nominal length before the extension. Stock 20 degrees below about 2000 rpm, 25 degrees above 2500 rpm. LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 05BDEC by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 00AAC0. Confidence: read.

table.name: Knock Window Overlap Margin (Event 1)
table.description:
For knock event slot 1, by rpm: how many degrees the knock window may run past the next event angle before the ECU flags an overlap, which changes how the knock signal background is adapted. Which cylinder slot 1 is has not been mapped. Stock 4-5 degrees.
Details: Knock window (0x0E2090 / 0x0E20E0, read): window start FFF8B118 = clamp(Knock Window Start(rpm), 0x1C210...0x1C212); nominal length FFF8B11C = Knock Window Length(rpm). The length used, FFF8B11A, is the nominal length plus Knock Window Length Extension only while timing FFF8A744 is at or below Knock Window Extension Timing Threshold (with hysteresis; MOVRT at 0x0E216E) and the extended window end (0x0E20E0 computes it from nominal + extension with the same formula 0x0E7CB0 uses for the window end FFF8A7AB) ends before the per-event angle FFF8C0E8 (built by 0x0E39C0 from FFF88860/FFF81478, inferred to be the next spark); if either fails the nominal length is used. Either way the length used is clamped to Knock Window Length Minimum...Maximum (0x1C1EC...0x1C1EE; 0x0E211E-0x0E2130 for the extended length, 0x0E21C0-0x0E21E8 for the nominal one, read). FFF8A7C1 / FFF8A7C2...C5 = 1 while the extended length is used (read, 0x0E20E0 at 0x0E21AA-0x0E21EC; corrected 2026-10-30). 0x0E7C00 / 0x0E7C24 scale start and length by FFF8CD46 into FFF8B12A / FFF8B12C for the window timer (1E5202, read). The rpm axis is FFF8CDC2 (rpm = x x 31.25 + 500, read). Degrees are crank degrees after the firing cylinder's TDC (reference inferred). 0x0E7328 loads this for event slot FFF8A798 = 1 into FFF8C1C8[0]; 0x0E9AF8-0x0E9C48 set the flag FFF8A7D2 when the window end passes the event angle by more than this many degrees (read). The flags feed the knock signal-processing block 0x0E4500 / 0x0E51E4: when a slot's flag changes while its window is nominal, 0x0E51E4 skips the background step and sets the background gain to the gain curve (flag 0 -> 1) or min(1024/gain, cal 0x26FAF) (1 -> 0) (read, Phase 18 review). Event slot vs cylinder number is not mapped. Stock 4-5 degrees. LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 05C0C8 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 00AD9C. Confidence: read.

table.name: Knock Background Window Step (Event 1, Channel 2)
table.description:
Knock signal processing for event slot 1, channel 2 (probably a frequency band of the knock sensor). For the one event where the knock window switches length, it shifts the channel's background reference so the switch does not read as knock. Larger = that event less likely to count as knock. Leave alone unless recalibrating knock detection.
Details: When used: event slot FFF8CDC0 = 1 (Event 1), knock channel 2 of 8 (index 1 of FFF8CDB0; enabled in stock: bit 1 of cal 0x1B97C is clear), on the knock window where FFF8A7C2 changes. Background step for this channel, added to (window extended) or subtracted from (window back to nominal) the channel background FFF8C180[1] for that one event; overlap-flag FFF8A7D2, gain curve cal 0x26F6F. Knock signal processing 0x0E51E4 (read; called once per knock window from 0x0E43B8 with load FFF8A616, after the event chain 0x0E433C): for the event slot FFF8CDC0 (1-4, the slot of the Knock Threshold tables) each of 8 knock channels i gets a reference ref_i = 32 x step_i + g x background_i, and the channel ratio is 256 x FFF8CDB0[i] / (ref_i / 32), i.e. measured / reference with 256 = equal (0x0E51E4 tail, read). Channels with their bit set in cal 0x1B97C..0x1B97F (per slot; stock 0xC1 = channels 1, 7 and 8 off) give 0; a channel flagged in FFF8CEED (driver flag, value at its lower limit, inferred) gives 256. The ratios are sorted and the largest min(cal 0x1B988, 5) = 3 are summed into the knock intensity FFF8C1C0[slot], which 0x0E80B4/0x0E8654 compare with Knock Threshold (read). The measured channels come from the knock sensor ADC: 0x1E7868 DMA-collects 32-sample blocks, 0x1E725A runs FFT-style butterflies, 0x1E73A4 takes sqrt(re^2+im^2) of 8 selected bins (pointer tables 0x34A88/0x34AA8), and 0x1E7724 sums them over the window into FFF8D1D4[8] -> FFF8CDB0[8] (read), so the 8 channels are 8 frequency bins of the knock sensor signal (inferred). background_i is the per-slot channel background FFF8C180.. (slot 1) / C190.. / C1A0.. / C1B0.. (slot 4), a lag filter of the measured channel kept by 0x0E4500 when the event is not knocking, floored at the per-channel rpm curve FFF8C0D8 (0x0E22A4) (read). step_i is this table family: it is non-zero only on the one event where the slot's window-length flag changes (cal 0x28B9E = 0 in stock selects these flags): +table when the flag goes 0 -> 1 (window switched to the extended length) and -table when it goes 1 -> 0 (back to the nominal length); on that event the reference is also floored at 32 x FFF8C0D8[i] (read). The flag is set when the extended knock window is used (0x0E20E0, read: B11A = nominal + Knock Window Length Extension only while timing FFF8A744 <= Knock Window Extension Timing Threshold and the extended window ends before the event angle). The step is skipped (0) and g is changed instead when the slot's overlap flag (FFF8A7D2..D5) changes while the window is nominal: g = gain curve cal (implicit rpm axis, x/32) on 0 -> 1 and min(1024 / gain, cal 0x26FAF = 64) on 1 -> 0, else g = 32 (x1.0) (read). On the event after a flag change 0x0E4500 resets the background almost fully to the new measurement (filter weight 255/256 while FFF8A7BC is set, read), so the step only bridges that single event: a larger value raises that channel's reference when the window lengthens (lower intensity, less likely to count as knock on that event) and lowers it when the window shortens (read). Axes: rpm FFF8CDC2 (x 31.25 + 500, 500-4000 rpm) x load FFF8A616 (read). Stock 0 to 70 (raw); the sibling tables for channels 1, 7 and 8 (masked in stock) are all 0. LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 05BE0C by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 00AAE0. Confidence: read.

table.name: Timing Retard High Load (1st Gear)
table.description:

table.name: Tip-Out Timing Retard
table.description:

table.name: Decel Fuel Cut Resume Timing Retard
table.description:

Event (read): with the pedal released, the engine running and the rpm change per event FFF8CEA6 >= cal 0x2FF56 (s16 -154 = -30 rpm per event; signed CMP/GE at 0x0DB000), an event starts when FFF8A774 bit 3 is set and rpm FFF8CE9C/128 (rpm/25) is below FFF8A62E. After cal 0x2FF50 (1) event with no change, FFF8B0DA = this table(coolant FFF88A44) << 7 for cal 0x2FF4F (10) combustion events; afterwards B0DA ramps back toward 0x4000 (no change) by cal 0x2FF58 - 0x4000 = 179/16384 per event (0.7 degrees per event). Pressing the pedal or a fast rpm drop cancels it (B0DA = 0x4000) (read). 0x0DB374: FFF8A753 = min(B0DA, B0DC) >> 7, the more retarding of this term and the 0x0DB21C term (05B718/05B724), and A753 is added in the 128-offset half-degree frame to the final timing sum (0x0D9E40, read). FFF8A63D bit 0 comes from bit 2, which 0x0C06F0 clears when the pedal is released and rpm/25 >= FFF8A62E (plus start-time and fault conditions) (read). So state 8 is the deceleration fuel cut and FFF8A62E its rpm threshold in 25 rpm units (inferred from the cut-cylinder count and the closed-pedal rpm test), and this table is a short retard when fuel returns because rpm fell to that threshold with the pedal still closed (read in Phase 19: limit state 8 is the staged decel fuel cut, A63D bit 0 held for 059D44 passes). 128 = no change, one count = 0.5 degree, negative = retard. Stock 0 up to 0 C (32 F), -8 at 10 C, -12 at 20 C, -16 at 30 C, -18 at 40 C, -25 degrees from 50 C (122 F). LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 05B70C by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 00A388. table.name: Decel Fuel Cut Recovery Timing Ramp (Closed-Pedal Resume)

B0DC = 0x4000 (no change) in state 3, cal 0x2FF12 << 7 (118: -5 degrees) in state 4, held in state 1, and in state 2 it climbs back to 0x4000 by (table(rpm FFF8CD54) - 0x4000) per event. FFF8A753 = min(Decel Fuel Cut Resume Timing Retard term B0DA, B0DC) >> 7 is added to the final timing sum (0x0DB374, 0x0D9E40), 128 = no change (read). Stock 17664 = 5.0 degrees per event at all rpm, so the -5 degree offset is gone on the first event. LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 05B718 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 00A394. Confidence: read.

table.name: A/C Cut Timing Retard Hold (RPM)
table.description:
When the A/C compressor switches off near standstill, the ECU retards timing 5 degrees for this many combustion events (one per 180 degrees of crank rotation), by rpm, then ramps the retard out. Probably smooths the idle load change. Stock 12 events from 650 to 1200 rpm (about 0.45 s at 800 rpm), 0 at 1400 rpm.
Details: When used: 0x0D8E3C (called from 0x0DF02C, args read): on the falling edge of FFF8A9A2 bit 6 (A/C compressor engaged, inferred in my research notes) while FFF88A3C < cal 0x2FE88, vehicle speed FFF99835 < cal 0x2FE90 (4 km/h), rpm FFF8CE9C within cal 0x2FE8E..0x2FE8C (500 rpm..max) and coolant >= cal 0x2FE8A, a hold counter FFF8A75D is loaded from this table (by rpm FFF8CE9C) and counted down per pass. While it runs, FFF8B0CC = cal 0x2FE82 (2560 = 10 half-degrees = 5 degrees); afterwards B0CC decays by cal 0x2FE84 (51) per pass. B0CC >> 8 is subtracted from the final timing sum FFF8A744 (0x0D9E40, read). Off while FFF88A2D bit 0 (engine stopped) or FFF8A65F bit 7. The alternate per-step table 05B410 (by FFF8A8C7) replaces cal 0x2FE82 only with cal 0x1D0AE bit 0 set (0 in stock). Stock 12 passes from 650 to 1200 rpm, 0 at 1400 rpm. AT/CVT version of Surge Damping Timing Curve (Gear 3). Not used on this manual-transmission calibration, so it has no effect on a stock car. Stock -20 degrees flat.
Details: When used: AT/CVT only (FFF88ADA bit 7 clear; it is always set on this manual coding), gear FFF88FCE = 3 (0x0DBB20, read: the AT/CVT curve branch, mirrored by the MT branch that reads Surge Damping Timing Curve (Gear 3); the MT coding flag s4 picks the MT curve). Full-scale timing correction (degrees, negative = retard) by the largest throttle-flow change FFF8B0EE since the trigger FFF8A7A1 bit 2 set (0x0DBB20 holds the maximum in FFF8B0F0 and resets it to 0 while the trigger is clear, read), before the phase, coolant, mode and cal factors (read). Surge damping term FFF8A758 (0x0DBB20, called from the 10 ms module 0x0DE0E0; stack args verified with callers.py: s0 = gear FFF88FCE, s4 = MT coding FFF88ADA bit 7, s8 = FFF8B0EE, s12 = rpm FFF8CE9C, s16 = FFF88C64 bit 5, s20 = combustion mode FFF8A85C, read): A758 = Curve(FFF8B0EE) x PhaseFactor(FFF8A75E) x CoolantFactor FFF8A75C x ModeFactor(A85C) x cal factor (MT coding: cal 0x306E5 = 254, or cal 0x306E7 = 128 once FFF88C64 bit 5 has been clear for cal 0x306E8 = 150 passes) / 255^4, in 0.5-degree units, capped at +63.5 degrees, and 0 when the trigger FFF8A7A1 bit 2 is clear or when the current swing count has lasted longer than its time cal 0x306EA..0x306FA (100/20/100/10/100/5/100/100/100 passes of 10 ms for counts 0..8) (read). A758 is added to the final timing sum in 0x0D9E40 (read), so negative values retard. Trigger (read): 0x0DC1E8 counts passes while FFF8A7A1 bit 3 is set, the throttle-flow change FFF8B0EE >= cal 0x3084E (131 = 0.4 % per 20 ms, MT; hysteresis 0x3084C) and FFF8B112 (0x0E0D14 of FFF88A3A) <= cal 0x30842; 0x0E1350 sets FFF8A7A1 bit 2 when that count exceeds a per-gear, per-rpm-band threshold (cals 0x30F62..0x30FAC); it is dropped after cal 0x30850 (90) active passes. FFF8A75E counts rpm swings (0x0DC324, see p17p_surge_phase). FFF88FCE is the gear: on the MT coding 0x08254C copies FFF8A8B6, which 0x11422C derives from the ratio gear FFF8A623 (read). Reading: a timing intervention after a throttle step that retards while rpm swings up and releases while it swings down, i.e. driveline surge (shuffle) damping (inferred from the structure; the stock odd-count-only factors fit it). Stock -20 degrees flat. LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 05B8B0 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 00A52C. Confidence: read.

table.name: Surge Damping Timing Phase Factor (Gear 1, Below 1800 RPM)
table.description:
Manual transmission, gear 1, below 1800 rpm: how much of the surge damping timing correction is applied at each step of the rpm swing count (0 = none, 1.0 = full). Appears to target the rpm-rising part of a driveline surge. Stock non-zero only at the rising counts 1, 3 and 5.
Details: When used: gear FFF88FCE = 1 on the MT coding (FFF88ADA bit 7) with rpm FFF8CE9C below cal 0x306E2 (9216 = 1800 rpm) (0x0DBB20, read). table.name: A/C Cut Timing Retard Step (Alternate Logic) (Off in Stock)

B0CC >> 8 is subtracted from the final timing sum (0x0D9E40) while the A/C Cut Timing Retard Hold counter runs, then decays (read).
