Rail pressure sensor voltage below which P0192 (circuit low) is set. Stock 0.23 V; change only with a different sensor.
Details: When used: while FFF88E66 bit 1 is set and FFF891D1 = 0. 0x06FDF8 (read): P0192 (FFF89B17 bit 6) is set when the rail pressure sensor sample FFF88D44 (ADC channel 17, 16-bit, untrimmed) is below this for cal 0x56710 (250) passes. Stock 3044 = 0.232 V (below the sensor's 0.5 V zero point). LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 05670C by the code that reads it (read). Address 060354. Confidence: read.

table.name: Rail Pressure Sensor Voltage High Limit (P0193)
table.description:
Rail pressure sensor voltage above which P0193 (circuit high) is set. Stock 3.25 V, which is about 20.6 MPa (2990 psi) with the stock sensor, a pressure the stock system should never reach.
Details: When used: while FFF88E66 bit 1 is set and FFF891D1 = 0. 0x06FDF8 (read): P0193 (FFF89B17 bit 7) is set when the rail pressure sensor sample FFF88D44 is above this for cal 0x56711 (250) passes. Stock 42647 = 3.254 V, which with the stock sensor conversion is 20.6 MPa (2990 psi): a reading the pump should never produce, so it is treated as a circuit fault (inferred). Raise it only together with a sensor or pump change. LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 05670E by the code that reads it (read). Address 060356. Confidence: read.

table.name: Rail Pressure Sensor Zero-Pressure Voltage
table.description:
Rail pressure sensor voltage that reads as zero pressure. Stock 0.50 V. Change it with Rail Pressure Sensor Gain only when fitting a different rail pressure sensor.
Details: When used: always (0x06D43A, read). Rail pressure FFF88F82 = Rail Pressure Sensor Gain x max(0, FFF88AAA - this) / 2, where FFF88AAA is the 10-bit sample of ADC channel 17 (FFF88D44 >> 6, 2 ms task 0x1E2AA2); the result is limited to Rail Pressure Sensor Maximum and becomes FFF88AAC and (filtered when FFF8A29C bit 0 is set) FFF88886, the rail pressure used by injection, the HPFP and the rail-pressure DTCs (read). Stock 102 = 0.498 V: the stock sensor reads 0 MPa at 0.5 V (inferred). For a different rail pressure sensor set this to its zero-pressure output. LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 057A46 by the code that reads it (read). Address 061690. Confidence: read.

table.name: Rail Pressure Sensor Gain
table.description:
Slope of the rail pressure sensor conversion. Stock about 1087 psi (7.5 MPa) per volt, so the stock sensor spans 0 at 0.5 V to about 4350 psi (30 MPa) at 4.5 V. Change it only for a different rail pressure sensor.
Details: When used: always (0x06D43A, read; a byte, read with MOVU.B). Rail pressure counts per 10-bit ADC count = this / 2 (counts of 0.61 kPa, 1639.34 per MPa). Stock 120 = 7.50 MPa (1087 psi) per volt, so the stock sensor spans 0 MPa at 0.5 V to 30.0 MPa at 4.5 V (inferred from the arithmetic and Rail Pressure Sensor Maximum = 30.0 MPa). For a different sensor: this = sensor MPa per V / 0.062464. LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 057A48 by the code that reads it (read). Address 061692. Confidence: read.

table.name: Rail Pressure Sensor Maximum
table.description:
Highest rail pressure the sensor conversion can report. Stock 30 MPa (about 4350 psi), the full span of the stock sensor.
Details: When used: always (0x06D43A, read): the converted rail pressure is limited to this (unsigned min, 0x753C) before it becomes FFF88AAC / FFF88886. Stock 49180 = 30.0 MPa (4351 psi), the full span of the stock sensor (inferred). LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 057A4A by the code that reads it (read). Address 061694. Confidence: read.

table.name: Rail Pressure Sensor Fault Value
table.description:
Rail pressure the ECU assumes while the rail pressure sensor is faulted. Stock about 51 psi (0.35 MPa). Normally leave alone.
Details: When used: while FFF88E2C bit 2 or FFF88EDA bit 7 is set (rail pressure sensor fault, inferred from the flags' use) the converted rail pressure is replaced by this (0x06D43A, read). Stock 574 = 0.35 MPa (51 psi). Normally leave alone. LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 057A50 by the code that reads it (read). Address 06169A. Confidence: read.

table.name: Barometric Sensor Multiplier
table.description:
Gain of the ECU's barometric pressure sensor conversion, in kPa per volt. Stock 22.2 kPa per volt. This sensor is probably inside the ECU; leave alone.
Details: When used: always (0x1D886A, read). Barometric pressure FFF8D060 (kPa x 256) = filtered sample FFF8D062 x this >> 8 + Barometric Sensor Offset, limited to 0...65535; FFF8D062 is a 3:1 running average of multiplexer channel 3 of ADC channel 12 (FFF8CA32, untrimmed). With 65536 = 5 V (inferred) the unit is kPa per volt = value / 5. Stock 111 = 22.2 kPa/V, so 101.3 kPa reads at 4.08 V. FFF8D060 -> FFF8CE60 -> FFF88668 (rate-limited by cals 0x1D0B2 / 0x1D0B4 = 34 per pass), the barometric pressure every baro table and gauge-pressure conversion uses (read). The sensor is not one of the externally wired inputs (inferred: no harness connector was identified); normally leave alone. LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 028CDC by the code that reads it (read). Address 03121C. Confidence: read.

table.name: Barometric Sensor Offset
table.description:
Offset of the barometric pressure sensor conversion. Stock 10.8 kPa. Leave alone.
Details: When used: always (0x1D886A, read): offset of the barometric pressure conversion in kPa x 256 (see Barometric Sensor Multiplier). Stock 2767 = 10.8 kPa. While the barometric sensor fault flag FFF88E2A bit 0 is set (passed to the driver as FFF8CA4C bit 7 by 0x1D766E, read) FFF8D060 is forced to 0x654C = 101.3 kPa. LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 028CDE by the code that reads it (read). Address 03121E. Confidence: read.

table.name: Barometric Sensor Enable [byte, bit 7 = 128]
table.description:
Bit 7 of this byte (value 128) is the switch: add 128 to set it, subtract 128 to clear it; leave the other bits as they are. When set (stock), the ECU uses its barometric pressure sensor. When cleared, it assumes sea-level pressure (101.3 kPa) everywhere, so altitude compensation stops working.
Details: When used: always. 0x06AA54 (via 0x06B66A, read): with this bit set the barometric pressure FFF88668 follows the sensor value FFF8CE60 (rate-limited by cals 0x1D0B2 / 0x1D0B4); with it clear FFF88668 is fixed at 0x654C = 101.3 kPa and FFF886DE / FFF886DA are not updated (0x1E220A, 0x06B650, read). Stock set (0x80). Clearing it makes every baro compensation assume sea level. LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 01D0BD by the code that reads it (read). Address 0235ED bit 7 (value 128). Confidence: read.

table.name: P0088 Rail Pressure High Limit
table.description:
Fuel rail pressure limit for P0088 (rail pressure too high): the code trips when actual pressure exceeds this value plus a 2.5 MPa hysteresis for about 2 seconds (17.5 MPa in stock), and also triggers fail-safe; after a trip, pressure must drop back to this value to recover. Stock 15.0 MPa. If you raise target rail pressure, keep peak actual pressure below this plus 2.5 MPa.
Details: 0x0752A8 (read): the absolute high-pressure test fails while actual FFF88884 > this + hysteresis cal 0x574DE (4098 = 2.5 MPa; the hysteresis widens the limit while the test is in its normal state, 0x6C4C) for cal 0x574E2 (200) passes, and recovers only when actual <= this; it sets FFF89BDE bit 2 -> P0088 and the fail-safe flag FFF88EDA bit 6 (0x080B96). Stock 24590 = 15.0 MPa, so the effective trip point is 17.5 MPa (28688 counts) and recovery is at 15.0 MPa. If you raise target rail pressure, keep peak actual pressure below this + 2.5 MPa, and keep this above the normal operating pressure so a tripped test can recover. p16 (read): 0x0752A8 (<- 0x0A1D2C <- 0x1DFE3C) runs every 10 ms; 200 passes = 2 s, 1000 passes = 10 s. LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 0574DC by the code that reads it (read). Address 061124. Confidence: read.

table.name: P0087 Rail Pressure Deviation Limit
table.description:
How far actual rail pressure may fall below target (in normal high-pressure pump operation) before P0087 sets, after about 10 seconds. Stock 3.3 MPa. Raising it makes the code harder to set.
Details: 0x0752A8 (read): in HPFP state FFF8AB35 = 3, target - actual > this for cal 0x574E6 (1000) passes sets P0087 (FFF89BDE bit 7 via bit 1); outside state 3 the limit is cal 0x577BA (65535 = off). Stock 5410 = 3.3 MPa. p16 (read): 0x0752A8 (<- 0x0A1D2C <- 0x1DFE3C) runs every 10 ms; 200 passes = 2 s, 1000 passes = 10 s. LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 0574EC by the code that reads it (read). Address 061134. Confidence: read.

table.name: P0088 Rail Pressure Deviation Limit
table.description:
How far actual rail pressure may rise above target (in normal high-pressure pump operation) before P0088 sets, after about 10 seconds. Stock 6.0 MPa. Raising it makes the code harder to set.
Details: 0x0752A8 (read): in HPFP state 3, actual - target > this for cal 0x574E8 (1000) passes sets P0088 (FFF89BDE bit 6 via bit 0); otherwise cal 0x577BC (off). Stock 9836 = 6.0 MPa. p16 (read): 0x0752A8 (<- 0x0A1D2C <- 0x1DFE3C) runs every 10 ms; 200 passes = 2 s, 1000 passes = 10 s. LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 0574EE by the code that reads it (read). Address 061136. Confidence: read.

table.name: P0087 Rail Pressure Low Limit
table.description:
Rail pressure floor by rpm for P0087 (rail pressure too low): the code counts a fault when actual pressure stays more than 0.30 MPa (hysteresis cal) below this value for about 10 seconds, i.e. below 0.40 MPa in stock, and recovers when pressure is back at this value. Stock 0.70 MPa at all rpm.
Details: 0x0752A8 (read, boot lookup 0x72AC): the absolute low-pressure test fails while actual rail pressure FFF88884 < this(rpm FFF8CD56) - hysteresis cal 0x574DA for cal 0x574E0 passes -> P0087. Stock 1148 = 0.70 MPa flat. p16 (read): 0x0752A8 (<- 0x0A1D2C <- 0x1DFE3C) runs every 10 ms; 200 passes = 2 s, 1000 passes = 10 s. LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 0609C4 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor boot 0635D0. Confidence: read.

table.name: Cold Start Timing Monitor Band (Coolant)
table.description:
Diagnostic threshold, not a tuning table: how far final timing may exceed the cold-start spark target, by coolant, before the P050B cold-start timing monitor counts a fault. One entry edits all three copies. Stock 8 degrees up to 75 C (167 F), no check (63.5) from 80 C (176 F).
Details: When used: one data block (0x04B0B2) read through three descriptors: 05B428, 0607FC and 060808 - this entry edits all three. (1) P050B cold-start timing monitor (0x1CB088 group): 0x1CB66C counts the passes where final timing FFF8A744 minus the active spark target FFF8A647 exceeds this (coolant FFF88A44), and 0x1CB6BC the passes where it does not, while the monitor runs (FFF8ADE2 bit 0) (read); see my research notes. (2) 0x0D8FC8: in the scan-tool mode set by UDS 0x2E DID 0x2004 (FFF89042 = 0xF0..0xF5, written by 0x0B0E6C, read) FFF8A729 = this + 0..10, added to the alternate timing path of 0x0D9E40 (read). Stock 16 = 8 degrees up to 167 F (75 C), 127 = 63.5 degrees (no check) from 176 F (80 C). Diagnostic, not a tuning table. LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 05B428 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 009FE4. Confidence: read.

table.name: A/F Imbalance Monitor Swing Threshold 1
table.description:
First reference for the P219A (A/F imbalance) monitor: how much the front A/F sensor reading may swing, by rpm and load, over the 25-second test window. Raising it makes P219A harder to set. A fault also needs A/F Imbalance Monitor Crank Roughness Threshold 1 to be exceeded. Above about 4000 rpm the reference climbs steeply (interpolating to the 4500 rpm row, which is effectively infinite), so running above about 4000 rpm during the window stops the test from failing.
Details: P219A also needs the crank-roughness confirmation: the channel judgements 0x18F980 / 0x18F928 report "exceeded" only when this reference is exceeded and the roughness latch from A/F Imbalance Monitor Crank Roughness Threshold 1 / 2 (05FC7C / 05FCDC) is set (read, Phase 19). When used: while the P219A monitor runs (FFF8ACCE bits 0 and 1). A/F imbalance monitor 0x18FF34 (10 ms task 0x1DFE3C) sets P219A (result FFF8ACCF bit 0, DTC monitor record slot 623, read). Over a window of cal 0x436D4 = 2500 passes (25 s) while its conditions FFF8ACCE bits 0/1 hold it sums the A/F-sensor swings, |change| of lambda x 8192 FFF88AF8 over each rising and falling run (FFF8C4E8, 0x18DB0C / 0x18DCCC, read), and two references: FFF8C4EC from 05FC10 and FFF8C4F0 from 05FC3C (0x18DD78 / 0x18DE88: per pass + table(rpm FFF8CE9C, load FFF8A616) x 05FC24/32 x 05FC30/16, both 1.0 in stock). At the window end measured > reference x coolant factor (05FD58/05FD70, 1.0 in stock) gives FFF8ACCE bit 4 / bit 2 (0x1913E0 / 0x19154C), judgements FFF8ACCB / FFF8ACCA = 2 and FFF8ACCF bit 1 / bit 3; either of these sets the P219A result in 0x19198C (read). This is the first reference (judgement FFF8ACCB, enabled by cal 0x436C0 = 1). Raising it makes P219A harder to set. Stock 12-67 per pass (0.0015-0.008 lambda) at 1500 rpm, up to 291 (0.036) at 2500-4000 rpm and 2.07 g/rev (160 % load); 65536168 from 4500 rpm (the sum saturates, so no failure can be found there). LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 05FC10 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 00EDD8. Confidence: read.

table.name: A/F Imbalance Monitor Swing Threshold 2
table.description:
Second, higher reference for the P219A (A/F imbalance) monitor, used with A/F Imbalance Monitor Crank Roughness Threshold 2 as confirmation. Raising it makes P219A harder to set. Above about 4000 rpm the reference climbs steeply (interpolating to the 4500 rpm row, which is effectively infinite), so running above about 4000 rpm during the window stops the test from failing.
Details: P219A also needs the crank-roughness confirmation: the channel judgements 0x18F980 / 0x18F928 report "exceeded" only when this reference is exceeded and the roughness latch from A/F Imbalance Monitor Crank Roughness Threshold 1 / 2 (05FC7C / 05FCDC) is set (read, Phase 19). When used: while the P219A monitor runs (FFF8ACCE bits 0 and 1). A/F imbalance monitor 0x18FF34 (10 ms task 0x1DFE3C) sets P219A (result FFF8ACCF bit 0, DTC monitor record slot 623, read). Over a window of cal 0x436D4 = 2500 passes (25 s) while its conditions FFF8ACCE bits 0/1 hold it sums the A/F-sensor swings, |change| of lambda x 8192 FFF88AF8 over each rising and falling run (FFF8C4E8, 0x18DB0C / 0x18DCCC, read), and two references: FFF8C4EC from 05FC10 and FFF8C4F0 from 05FC3C (0x18DD78 / 0x18DE88: per pass + table(rpm FFF8CE9C, load FFF8A616) x 05FC24/32 x 05FC30/16, both 1.0 in stock). At the window end measured > reference x coolant factor (05FD58/05FD70, 1.0 in stock) gives FFF8ACCE bit 4 / bit 2 (0x1913E0 / 0x19154C), judgements FFF8ACCB / FFF8ACCA = 2 and FFF8ACCF bit 1 / bit 3; either of these sets the P219A result in 0x19198C (read). This is the second reference (judgement FFF8ACCA, enabled by cal 0x436C1 = 1); it is higher than Threshold 1 and its judgement additionally needs FFF8ACD6 / FFF8ACDB (FFF8ACDB = the crank-roughness latch of A/F Imbalance Monitor Crank Roughness Threshold 2, 0x191920; FFF8ACD6 not decoded) instead of FFF8ACD4 / FFF8ACD8. Stock 40-200 per pass at 1500 rpm, up to 511 (0.062 lambda) at 2500 rpm / 2.07 g/rev (160 % load); 65536168 from 4500 rpm. LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 05FC3C by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 00EE04. Confidence: read.

table.name: EGR Enable [byte, bit 5 = 32]
table.description:
Bit 5 of this byte (value 32) is the switch: add 32 to set it, subtract 32 to clear it; leave the other bits as they are. Master switch for EGR (set in stock). Clearing it is expected to keep EGR off, so the EGR-off variants of base timing, closed loop target and throttle tables become the live ones (inferred).
Details: Set in stock. One of the EGR enable conditions computed by 0x0FAAFC (FFF8A811 bit 0), with coolant, rpm and load windows, engine running and normal combustion mode (read). Clearing it is expected to keep EGR off, so the EGR-off table variants (Base Timing (EGR Off, ...), Closed Loop Target (..., EGR Off), the non-EGR Throttle Opening from Target Torque tables) become the live ones (inferred). LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 02F796 by its caller in the decompiled code (read). Evidence: (read) Caller of 0x104210 sets uStack_38 = (DAT_00037fee & 0x20) and passes it as param_8 (param_3 = 0x37FEF bit6, LF75404S 0x2F797 bit6); 0x103268 (pair of 0x0F9C3C) passes (DAT_00037fee & 0x20) to 0x104744 (pair of 0x0FB088). Stock 0x20 (bit5 set). Address 037FEE bit 5 (value 32). Confidence: read.

table.name: Transmission Coding: Automatic/CVT [byte, bit 1 = 2]
table.description:
Bit 1 of this byte (value 2) is the switch: add 2 to set it, subtract 2 to clear it; leave the other bits as they are. Tells the ECU whether it is in a manual or an AT/CVT car (clear = manual in every manual image). It decides gear calculation, the gear torque limits and whether the AT/CVT Coding table variants are used. Do not change on a manual car.
Details: Clear in every manual image (byte 0xFD) and set in the 2016 CVT image LF75300G (0xFB) (read, my research notes). While Transmission Coding: From Input Port is clear, FFF886AB bit 7 (manual coding) = NOT this bit (read, 0x06A38C at 0x06A73A..0x06A824). The bit is also read directly, whatever From Input Port says, by 0x0B83F8 (0x0B8544 / 0x0B8514 -> FFF8A618 bits 0/1 -> 0x0B8154, read; meaning not identified). With the manual coding: gear is computed from the rpm/speed ratio (0x0B914C), Requested Torque uses its A tables only, the gear torque limit table applies (0x0BB1AC), and the flag-set table variants are the live ones; with automatic/CVT coding the gear and a torque limit come from a received CAN frame and the AT/CVT Coding table variants are used (read; meaning inferred). Do not change on a manual car. LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 02F794 by the code that reads it (read). Address 037FEC bit 1 (value 2). Confidence: read.

table.name: Transmission Coding: From Input Port [byte, bit 6 = 64]
table.description:
Bit 6 of this byte (value 64) is the switch: add 64 to set it, subtract 64 to clear it; leave the other bits as they are. When set, the manual/automatic coding is read from a hardware input instead of Transmission Coding: Automatic/CVT. Clear in all stock images; leave clear.
Details: Clear in all stock images. When set, the transmission coding (FFF886AB bit 7) is taken from a latched input-port bit (FFF80238 bit 7, set once port bit FFF8A2A4 bit 7 is seen) instead of Transmission Coding: Automatic/CVT (read, 0x06A38C). Leave clear. LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 02F796 by its caller in the decompiled code (read). Evidence: (read) 0x06D124 (pair of 0x06A38C): (DAT_00037fee & 0x40) == 0 selects DAT_00037fec & 2, else latched input port, as LF75404S 0x2F796 bit6. Shared byte with EGR Enable (bit5) is correct. Stock byte 0x20 (bit6 clear). Address 037FEE bit 6 (value 64). Confidence: read.

table.name: Target Torque Rise: Enable Path B [byte, bit 6 = 64]
table.description:
Bit 6 of this byte (value 64) is the switch: add 64 to set it, subtract 64 to clear it; leave the other bits as they are. Enables the second (Path B) tip-in torque shaping. Clear in stock, and all Path B tables are 0 and its rpm limit is 0, so setting only this bit does essentially nothing. Leave clear unless you calibrate the whole Path B set.
Details: Clear in stock (byte 0x01). The torque module 0x0BE694 passes this bit to the rise shaping 0x0BB958 (BLD.B #6 at 0x0BF3D0, stack argument 11, read), and the torque monitor call passes it to 0x1877B4 (read). When set, Path B of the target-torque rise shaping can act (all "Target Torque Rise ... (Path B, ..., Off in Stock)" tables), and a request below Path B Start Torque passes unshaped. Path B also needs rpm <= cal 0x22A04, which is 0 in stock, so setting only this bit changes nothing but the Start Torque bypass (and Path B tables are all 0 ft-lb in stock, so that bypass never triggers). Leave clear unless the whole Path B set is calibrated. Bit 7 of the same byte is a separate switch passed to another torque routine (seg_0x0B0000.c:9252). LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 023704 by its caller in the decompiled code (read). Evidence: the rise-shaping function 0x0C3FE8 (counterpart of LF75404S 0x0BB958; it reads the Path B pedal multiplier table) is called once, with (cal 0x2A9B8 & 0x40) as its only bit-6 cal flag argument, as LF75404S passes cal 0x23704 bit 6 (read); stock byte 0x01 (bit 6 clear). Address 02A9B8 bit 6 (value 64). Confidence: read.

table.name: Open Loop Fueling: Use Alternate Map [byte, bit 4 = 16]
table.description:
Bit 4 of this byte (value 16) is the switch: add 16 to set it, subtract 16 to clear it; leave the other bits as they are. When set, Primary Open Loop Fueling (Alternate, Off in Stock) probably replaces the normal open loop fueling strategy. Clear in stock; leave clear unless you have filled that table.
Details: Clear in stock (byte 0x8F). Passed by the open-loop fueling readers 0x0CE854 and 0x0CE5E8 (read): when set, Primary Open Loop Fueling (Alternate, Off in Stock) is used in place of the base + DAM-scaled knock additive strategy (inferred). Leave clear unless you have filled that table. LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 02F79A by the code that reads it (read). Address 037FF2 bit 4 (value 16). Confidence: read.

table.name: VE: Use AVCS-Not-Ready Table [byte, bit 0 = 1]
table.description:
Bit 0 of this byte (value 1) is the switch: add 1 to set it, subtract 1 to clear it; leave the other bits as they are. When set, Volumetric Efficiency (AVCS Not Ready, Off in Stock) is used while the cams are probably not yet under control. Clear in stock; leave clear.
Details: Clear in stock. 0x11E308 uses Volumetric Efficiency (AVCS Not Ready, Off in Stock) only when this bit is set and FFF8A83B bit 7 is clear (read); FFF8A83B bit 7 = AVCS ready (inferred). Leave clear. LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 02C4D0 by the code that reads it (read). Address 034B00 bit 0 (value 1). Confidence: read.

table.name: Base Timing: Pedal-Released Tables Enable [byte, bit 0 = 1]
table.description:
Bit 0 of this byte (value 1) is the switch: add 1 to set it, subtract 1 to clear it; leave the other bits as they are. Set in stock: with the pedal released, Base Timing (Pedal Released, TGV Closed/Open) replaces the normal EGR Active/Off base timing tables. Clear it to use the normal base timing tables off-throttle too.
Details: Set in stock (all images). With this bit set and FFF8A774 bit 0 (pedal released) set, Base Timing (Pedal Released, TGV Closed/Open) replaces the EGR Active/Off base timing tables (read, 0x0C2C08). Clear it to use the normal base timing tables with the pedal released. LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 01071E by the code that reads it (read). Address 01071E bit 0 (value 1). Confidence: read.

table.name: Multi-Injection Allowed During High-Pedal Latch 1 [byte, bit 0 = 1]
table.description:
Bit 0 of this byte (value 1) is the switch: add 1 to set it, subtract 1 to clear it; leave the other bits as they are. Allows double/triple injection while one of the high-pedal latches is set (clear = not allowed; clear in stock). Has no effect on a stock car because the multi-injection windows are disabled, so stock always uses single injection.
Details: Clear in stock (byte 0xE0). The multi-injection enable FFF8A775 bit 0 (0x10B650) requires the high-pedal latch FFF8A8A3 bit 6 to be clear unless this bit is set (read; the pairing of bit and latch follows the argument order at the call in 0x109008, inferred). Only matters if the double/triple injection windows are opened (they are 65535 in stock, so stock always uses single injection). LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 02996D by its caller in the decompiled code (read). Evidence: the multi-injection enable call (counterpart of LF75404S 0x10B650 called from 0x109008) passes bits 0, 1 and 2 of cal 0x31EAD as the three latch-allow arguments, in the same order (read); stock byte 0xE0 as in 2015 (read). Address 031EAD bit 0 (value 1). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Multi-Injection Allowed During High-Pedal Latch 2 [byte, bit 1 = 2]
table.description:
Bit 1 of this byte (value 2) is the switch: add 2 to set it, subtract 2 to clear it; leave the other bits as they are. Allows double/triple injection while a second high-pedal latch is set (clear in stock). Has no effect on a stock car because the multi-injection windows are disabled, so stock always uses single injection.
Details: Clear in stock (byte 0xE0). table.name: Class (Circuit) Mask (bit per DTC)
table.category: 11.03 Diagnostics & Switches - DTC Enable Switches - DTC - Class (Circuit)
table.description: 11.03 Diagnostics & Switches - DTC Enable Switches - DTC - Class (Circuit), one byte per row (0x4ED9B + row). Each code is one bit: b0 = 1, b1 = 2, b2 = 4, b3 = 8, b4 = 16, b5 = 32, b6 = 64, b7 = 128. The value is the sum of the set bits; clear a code by subtracting its bit value. Same bits as the RomRaider switches in this category.
